## What sets us apart

[What sets us apart]

### We're all about sharing the joy of travel 

For over 35 years, we’ve led travellers around the world to share in the real, rare and remarkable.
We’re beyond grateful for what travel gives us – and we’re all for giving back through The Intrepid
Foundation by supporting communities worldwide, and we’re proud to be B Corp certified since 2018.  

[Read about our purpose ][230]

### Small group experts

We’ve specialised in real, rare and remarkable small group adventures since 1989.

### Book now, pay later

Lock in your adventure with a deposit on selected trips* [T&Cs apply.][231]

### Local leaders, local expertise

Travel with the people who know it best — with experienced leaders to guide you along the way.

### No additional surcharges

On selected 2026 Intrepid trips* [T&Cs apply][232]

### Blue Dragon Marathon Walk

This September, walk with us to help end human trafficking. No matter how far you go, your impact
goes even further. Plus, your fundraising could put you in the running to win an Intrepid trip worth
up to AU$3,500.

[Walk with us][233]

## What sets us apart

[What sets us apart]

### We're all about sharing the joy of travel 

For over 35 years, we’ve led travellers around the world to share in the real, rare and remarkable.
We’re beyond grateful for what travel gives us – and we’re all for giving back through The Intrepid
Foundation by supporting communities worldwide, and we’re proud to be B Corp certified since 2018.  

[Read about our purpose ][230]

### Small group experts

We’ve specialised in real, rare and remarkable small group adventures since 1989.

### Book now, pay later

Lock in your adventure with a deposit on selected trips* [T&Cs apply.][231]

### Local leaders, local expertise

Travel with the people who know it best — with experienced leaders to guide you along the way.

### No additional surcharges

On selected 2026 Intrepid trips* [T&Cs apply][232]

### Blue Dragon Marathon Walk

This September, walk with us to help end human trafficking. No matter how far you go, your impact
goes even further. Plus, your fundraising could put you in the running to win an Intrepid trip worth
up to AU$3,500.

[Walk with us][233]

# Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort

## Unwind in Aruba's Tropical Paradise

Experience a truly unique stay on the pristine shores of Aruba’s Eagle Beach, consistently ranked
among the best beaches in the Caribbean. At Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, we combine luxurious
accommodations with warm, attentive service that makes every guest feel at home. As a boutique hotel
in Aruba with just 72 rooms, we specialize in personalized hospitality, creating unforgettable
moments through genuine care, welcoming smiles, and exceptional attention to detail.

[ Explore Our Amenities ][4]
[Exterior view of Two Bedroom Suite with surroundings at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]
[Aerail view of the hotel exterior and amenities at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]

The architectural charm of our resort adds a distinctive character to your experience. Surrounded by
lush tropical greenery, our comfortable pool, complete with a cascading waterfall, sets the tone for
a relaxed, tropical rhythm. Step inside, and you'll find Dutch colonial elegance seamlessly blended
with contemporary luxury. Our architecture comes to life through vibrant sunflower yellows and
tranquil sky blues, infusing every corner with a visual charm that creates an ambiance both inviting
and captivating.

These elements embody the very essence of Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, distinguishing us in the
world of hospitality. More than just a hotel, we are a destination where cherished memories are
made, one thoughtful detail at a time. The only thing missing is you. Join us at Amsterdam Manor
Beach Resort to craft your unforgettable Aruba experience.

## Elevate Your Stay: The Penthouse Experience.

Elevate your Aruba escape in our signature Penthouse Suite, where sophistication meets the sea. With
panoramic views of Eagle Beach, spacious living areas, and a private terrace made for Aruba’s
breathtaking sunsets, every moment here feels extraordinary.

Perched above the resort, this Penthouse captures the essence of refined island living in Aruba
where elegant interiors, contemporary design, and the island’s radiant light create an effortless
sense of serenity. Two beautifully appointed bedrooms, a full kitchen, and an expansive living area
open onto a private terrace overlooking the Caribbean.

Whether savoring gentle ocean breezes or toasting beneath Aruba’s star-filled skies, the Penthouse
is where your most unforgettable island memories unfold.

[ Learn More opens in a new tab ][5]

## Honeymoon Suite Aruba

Escape to your private Aruba sanctuary for two, where island elegance meets effortless romance. With
a luxurious king-sized bed, soothing modern design, and a terrace made for sunsets, the Honeymoon
Suite is where unforgettable moments begin.

Nestled in the heart of our Aruba resort, this intimate retreat is designed for connection and calm.
A beautifully appointed bedroom with a spa-inspired bathroom and modern bathtub creates a haven of
relaxation, while the open living and dining area invites quiet moments together.

Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen and step onto your private terrace to savor the
warm Aruba breezes as the sun sets over the Caribbean. Every detail ambient lighting, smart TVs,
high-speed WiFi, and advanced air-quality control ensures complete comfort. More than a suite, it’s
where your Aruba love story begins.

[ Begin Your Honeymoon opens in a new tab ][6]

# Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort

## Unwind in Aruba's Tropical Paradise

Experience a truly unique stay on the pristine shores of Aruba’s Eagle Beach, consistently ranked
among the best beaches in the Caribbean. At Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, we combine luxurious
accommodations with warm, attentive service that makes every guest feel at home. As a boutique hotel
in Aruba with just 72 rooms, we specialize in personalized hospitality, creating unforgettable
moments through genuine care, welcoming smiles, and exceptional attention to detail.

[ Explore Our Amenities ][4]
[Exterior view of Two Bedroom Suite with surroundings at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]
[Aerail view of the hotel exterior and amenities at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort]

The architectural charm of our resort adds a distinctive character to your experience. Surrounded by
lush tropical greenery, our comfortable pool, complete with a cascading waterfall, sets the tone for
a relaxed, tropical rhythm. Step inside, and you'll find Dutch colonial elegance seamlessly blended
with contemporary luxury. Our architecture comes to life through vibrant sunflower yellows and
tranquil sky blues, infusing every corner with a visual charm that creates an ambiance both inviting
and captivating.

These elements embody the very essence of Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort, distinguishing us in the
world of hospitality. More than just a hotel, we are a destination where cherished memories are
made, one thoughtful detail at a time. The only thing missing is you. Join us at Amsterdam Manor
Beach Resort to craft your unforgettable Aruba experience.

## Elevate Your Stay: The Penthouse Experience.

Elevate your Aruba escape in our signature Penthouse Suite, where sophistication meets the sea. With
panoramic views of Eagle Beach, spacious living areas, and a private terrace made for Aruba’s
breathtaking sunsets, every moment here feels extraordinary.

Perched above the resort, this Penthouse captures the essence of refined island living in Aruba
where elegant interiors, contemporary design, and the island’s radiant light create an effortless
sense of serenity. Two beautifully appointed bedrooms, a full kitchen, and an expansive living area
open onto a private terrace overlooking the Caribbean.

Whether savoring gentle ocean breezes or toasting beneath Aruba’s star-filled skies, the Penthouse
is where your most unforgettable island memories unfold.

# St. Augustine Beach Bed & Breakfast

Oceanfront Bed & Breakfast beach resort on beautiful St. Augustine Beach. Located just 10 minutes
from the historic town of St. Augustine, our bed and breakfast inn is perfect for adults looking to
get the most out of their stay. St. Augustine, the nation’s oldest city is a special place that’s
rich in history, art and culture. Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is exclusively for-grown-ups.

A romantic **St. Augustine beachfront hotel** that features an unparalleled beachfront location
providing breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean. Known as that special place for honeymooners,
anniversaries, birthdays and special occasions, Beachfront B & B is where dreams come true. When
looking for a **St. Augustine bed & breakfast** that can ensure your stay will be one to remember,
look no further than Beachfront Bed & Breakfast.

[St Augustine Beach House and Pool]

## Oceanfront Accommodations!

The main oceanfront beach house has four rooms and the cottage located behind the beach house has
three rooms. All rooms have a private bathroom. Fine amenities include an outdoor heated pool (open
for swimming when the outdoor temperature is above 62°) and Jacuzzi, award-winning landscaped
gardens and delicious hot, full breakfasts. The Beach House also has a second-floor great room and
oceanfront Verandah with comfortable seating, cookies, coffee, and amazing ocean views. Friendly
ambiance and personalized service are the signature of this** charming bed & breakfast on the
ocean**.

When searching for **hotels in St. Augustine**, you shouldn’t settle for anything less than perfect.
With countless charming rooms to choose from and access to a variety of luxurious amenities,
Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is perfect for couples young and old to fall in love all over again.

# St. Augustine Beach Bed & Breakfast

Oceanfront Bed & Breakfast beach resort on beautiful St. Augustine Beach. Located just 10 minutes
from the historic town of St. Augustine, our bed and breakfast inn is perfect for adults looking to
get the most out of their stay. St. Augustine, the nation’s oldest city is a special place that’s
rich in history, art and culture. Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is exclusively for-grown-ups.

A romantic **St. Augustine beachfront hotel** that features an unparalleled beachfront location
providing breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean. Known as that special place for honeymooners,
anniversaries, birthdays and special occasions, Beachfront B & B is where dreams come true. When
looking for a **St. Augustine bed & breakfast** that can ensure your stay will be one to remember,
look no further than Beachfront Bed & Breakfast.

[St Augustine Beach House and Pool]

## Oceanfront Accommodations!

The main oceanfront beach house has four rooms and the cottage located behind the beach house has
three rooms. All rooms have a private bathroom. Fine amenities include an outdoor heated pool (open
for swimming when the outdoor temperature is above 62°) and Jacuzzi, award-winning landscaped
gardens and delicious hot, full breakfasts. The Beach House also has a second-floor great room and
oceanfront Verandah with comfortable seating, cookies, coffee, and amazing ocean views. Friendly
ambiance and personalized service are the signature of this** charming bed & breakfast on the
ocean**.

When searching for **hotels in St. Augustine**, you shouldn’t settle for anything less than perfect.
With countless charming rooms to choose from and access to a variety of luxurious amenities,
Beachfront Bed & Breakfast is perfect for couples young and old to fall in love all over again.

Please note that our property offers limited accessible features at the present time, such as a some
ground floor rooms, however to do more would not be readily achievable given the specifics of the
property.  Please call or email us directly so that we may assist in every way possible.

**Our other rental options:**
* [La Fiesta Ocean Inn & Suites][114]– For families, couples, and girlfriend getaways. Located one
  block away from Beachfront Bed & Breakfast, with a private boardwalk to the beach.

**House and Cottage Rentals – all within a block of the ocean and Beachfront Bed & Breakfast:**
* [View all six of of house and cottage rentals][115]
* [Oceanfront Beach House – Newly Renovated & Furnished][116] 2 bedroom, 2 bath, pet-friendly.
  Sleeps up to 6.
* [Luxurious 3-story ocean view private home][117] with elevator, rooftop ocean view deck, and
  private heated pool. Sleeps up to 10.
* [Beachside Magnificent Estate Family Home][118] – Incredible ocean view, private heated pool.
  Sleeps up to 11.
* [Pet-friendly 2nd floor, ocean facing 2 bedroom unit][119] with large kitchen, balcony with
  partial ocean view. Sleeps 4.
* [Sand Dollar East Cottage][120] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach
* [Sand Dollar West Cottage][121] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach

## Florida Beach Getaway

The intimate setting of this exclusive bed & breakfast inn lends itself to a truly enjoyable and
memorable experience. Stunning ocean views, tranquil atmosphere and spectacular sunrises make this
the perfect romantic hideaway. Relax and enjoy the heated pool (open for swimming when the outdoor
temperature is above 62°), large outdoor Jacuzzi, and oversized hammock for two that beckons for
couples to relax and unwind on over two acres of lush, oceanfront property that is quiet & relaxing
and just for grown-ups. It’s a great place when you are looking for a hotel in St. Augustine, FL.

Looking to have deluxe beach chairs and an umbrella set up and waiting for you in the sand each
morning? This is possible with Barney’s Beach Service. Click [here][122] for details. Barney’s also
has a variety of other items, like bicycles, boogie boards, surf boards, and paddle boards.

[ VIEW ROOM OPTIONS][123]
[Veranda]

## Beach and History

St. Augustine is well known for more than pristine beaches. The Nation’s oldest city is rich in
history, charm and culture. Take part in the exploration of its fine history which includes
everything from a 17th century fortress to many 18th century buildings representing the historical
richness of the city. There are many choices of activities when you stay at **St. Augustine beach
resorts** – museums, fine shops and restaurants, galleries and a calendar packed with events all
during the year.

  block away from Beachfront Bed & Breakfast, with a private boardwalk to the beach.

**House and Cottage Rentals – all within a block of the ocean and Beachfront Bed & Breakfast:**
* [View all six of of house and cottage rentals][115]
* [Oceanfront Beach House – Newly Renovated & Furnished][116] 2 bedroom, 2 bath, pet-friendly.
  Sleeps up to 6.
* [Luxurious 3-story ocean view private home][117] with elevator, rooftop ocean view deck, and
  private heated pool. Sleeps up to 10.
* [Beachside Magnificent Estate Family Home][118] – Incredible ocean view, private heated pool.
  Sleeps up to 11.
* [Pet-friendly 2nd floor, ocean facing 2 bedroom unit][119] with large kitchen, balcony with
  partial ocean view. Sleeps 4.
* [Sand Dollar East Cottage][120] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach
* [Sand Dollar West Cottage][121] – Ground floor one bedroom pet-friendly cottage rental, very close
  to the beach

## Florida Beach Getaway

The intimate setting of this exclusive bed & breakfast inn lends itself to a truly enjoyable and
memorable experience. Stunning ocean views, tranquil atmosphere and spectacular sunrises make this
the perfect romantic hideaway. Relax and enjoy the heated pool (open for swimming when the outdoor
temperature is above 62°), large outdoor Jacuzzi, and oversized hammock for two that beckons for
couples to relax and unwind on over two acres of lush, oceanfront property that is quiet & relaxing
and just for grown-ups. It’s a great place when you are looking for a hotel in St. Augustine, FL.

Looking to have deluxe beach chairs and an umbrella set up and waiting for you in the sand each
morning? This is possible with Barney’s Beach Service. Click [here][122] for details. Barney’s also
has a variety of other items, like bicycles, boogie boards, surf boards, and paddle boards.

[ VIEW ROOM OPTIONS][123]
[Veranda]

## Beach and History

St. Augustine is well known for more than pristine beaches. The Nation’s oldest city is rich in
history, charm and culture. Take part in the exploration of its fine history which includes
everything from a 17th century fortress to many 18th century buildings representing the historical
richness of the city. There are many choices of activities when you stay at **St. Augustine beach
resorts** – museums, fine shops and restaurants, galleries and a calendar packed with events all
during the year.

souvenirs. We provide custom souvenirs for not only the small Mom and Pop souvenirs shop but Big Box

[Start Your Beach Journey][33]

The United States has over 23 coastal states with thousands of unique beaches—from the white sands
of Florida's Gulf Coast to rugged cliffs in Oregon. Whether you're chasing waves, looking for family
activities, or searching for hidden gems, Beachory brings you verified, up-to-date beach info.

Beachory: Quick FAQs

### What does Beachory do?

Beachory helps you plan smarter beach trips with practical, decision-ready info: **parking**,
**entrances**, **restrooms**, accessibility notes, and clear maps. You can also browse curated
collections like [Family-friendly][34], [Surfing][35], [Sunrise][36], [Sunset][37], and [Best for
Photos][38]. Think of Beachory as a focused beach guide that saves time and avoids surprises.

### How should I search for beaches?

Start with a **state** or **city**, then refine by the experience you want. You can jump into hubs
like [Florida beaches][39], [California beaches][40], or [Maryland beaches][41]. We keep internal
links *stable* for SEO and reliability—only clean parameters like state/city/experience/page; we
never put volatile latitude/longitude or tracking params in crawlable links.

### What will I find on a beach page?

A beach page summarizes what matters most before you go: where to park, how to reach the **closest
entrance**, what **amenities** exist (restrooms, showers, lifeguards, food nearby), accessibility
notes, photos, maps, and community tips. When available, we also include vibe/context—crowds, family
suitability, or photo spots—so you can set expectations and plan the best time to visit.

### Parking: what should I expect and how do I avoid hassles?

Beach parking rules can vary by city and season. Look for details on whether lots are **free or
paid**, if there’s time-limited street parking, and whether payment apps or permits are required.

The United States has over 23 coastal states with thousands of unique beaches—from the white sands
of Florida's Gulf Coast to rugged cliffs in Oregon. Whether you're chasing waves, looking for family
activities, or searching for hidden gems, Beachory brings you verified, up-to-date beach info.

Beachory: Quick FAQs

### What does Beachory do?

Beachory helps you plan smarter beach trips with practical, decision-ready info: **parking**,
**entrances**, **restrooms**, accessibility notes, and clear maps. You can also browse curated
collections like [Family-friendly][34], [Surfing][35], [Sunrise][36], [Sunset][37], and [Best for
Photos][38]. Think of Beachory as a focused beach guide that saves time and avoids surprises.

### How should I search for beaches?

Start with a **state** or **city**, then refine by the experience you want. You can jump into hubs
like [Florida beaches][39], [California beaches][40], or [Maryland beaches][41]. We keep internal
links *stable* for SEO and reliability—only clean parameters like state/city/experience/page; we
never put volatile latitude/longitude or tracking params in crawlable links.

### What will I find on a beach page?

A beach page summarizes what matters most before you go: where to park, how to reach the **closest
entrance**, what **amenities** exist (restrooms, showers, lifeguards, food nearby), accessibility
notes, photos, maps, and community tips. When available, we also include vibe/context—crowds, family
suitability, or photo spots—so you can set expectations and plan the best time to visit.

### Parking: what should I expect and how do I avoid hassles?

Beach parking rules can vary by city and season. Look for details on whether lots are **free or
paid**, if there’s time-limited street parking, and whether payment apps or permits are required.
When lots fill early on weekends, consider arriving before mid-morning or target weekday afternoons.
Always check signs on arrival and avoid blocking driveways or emergency access—tickets near popular
beaches can be costly.

### Accessibility: which beaches are easier with strollers or wheelchairs?

We highlight **stroller and wheelchair access** wherever possible—boardwalks, beach mats, ramps, and
accessible restrooms make a big difference. If mobility is a priority, prefer beaches with paved or
hard-packed paths, close-in parking, and lifeguard stations that list accessibility notes. You can
also filter by family-friendly amenities and look for on-map entrance markers located near
facilities.

### Safety: lifeguards, flags, rip currents, and basic precautions?

If you plan to swim, choose beaches with **lifeguards** and check local flag systems on arrival.
Avoid rip currents by swimming near guards, staying within your depth, and learning escape
techniques (swim parallel to shore to exit a rip). Give extra space during surf days or strong
winds, and keep kids within arm’s reach when waves pick up. When in doubt, ask lifeguards—they’re
the best local resource.

### When is the best time to visit: crowds, seasons, and conditions?

Crowds swell on sunny weekend middays. For a calmer experience, try **early mornings**, weekdays, or
shoulder seasons. If you’re after golden-hour photos, check our [Sunrise][42] and [Sunset][43]
lists. In shoulder months, water can be cooler and some amenities limited—packing layers, snacks,
and a backup plan helps.

### Pets: what should I know before bringing my dog?

Pet rules change by city and season—some beaches allow dogs on-leash during specific hours, others
restrict access during nesting seasons. Check signage on arrival, bring fresh water, and keep waste
bags handy. To find easier options, look for **Pet-friendly** indicators and consider less busy
times so your dog can adjust calmly.

### Photography tips: getting great Sunrise/Sunset shots without the crowds?

For **sunrise**, arrive 20–30 minutes early to catch blue hour and first light; for **sunset**, stay
10–15 minutes after the sun dips for pastel tones. Use leading lines (boardwalks, lifeguard towers),
include foreground (dune grass, rocks), and bring a microfiber cloth to manage sea spray. Explore
[Best for Photos][44] for ideas.

### Traveling with kids: how do I plan a smoother day?

Choose **Family-friendly** beaches with restrooms, lifeguards, and nearby food. Pack shade, snacks,
and dry clothes; bring sand toys and a soft cooler. Arrive early for close parking and gentler
conditions, and consider calmer bays or lakes if ocean waves are high. Mark your landmark (e.g., a
colorful umbrella) so kids can find your spot.

### Leave No Trace: how can I reduce my impact?

Keep beaches beautiful: pack out all trash, avoid walking on dunes, and respect wildlife and nesting
areas. Use reef-safe sunscreen, minimize single-use plastics, and keep music to considerate levels.
If you see litter, a quick cleanup helps more than you think—popular beaches need everyone’s care to
stay pristine.

We combine editorial curation, structured data, and community feedback. Our focus is on **useful
accuracy**: entrances, parking, accessibility, restrooms, and on-the-ground context. We continually
improve coverage across coastal states, and we prioritize clarity over fluff so you can make
decisions quickly.

park, which entrance to use, what amenities exist, and whether the spot suits your group. Our
[Trending][45] and experience pages provide quick, focused starting points, so planning is fast and
confident.

[California][47] for surf towns and dramatic coasts, or [Maryland][48] for calm, family-friendly
shores. Then narrow to [Family-friendly][49], [Surfing][50], or [Best for Photos][51] depending on
your plans.

a canopy of palm trees? No matter what your vision for your special day, our experts have the

When it comes to planning the perfect honeymoon, we’ve got you covered. Our experts have planned
some of the most beautiful experiences for couples for over 20 years. We can guide you from the
inspiration phase all the way to what to wear to the airport. We can make your dream honeymoon come
true.

[Contact Us Today][31]

## [Renewing Your Vows][32]

Whether it’s been a year, a decade or more, there’s nothing more romantic than renewing your vows in
a beautiful new destination or going back to where it all began. We can help with every last detail,
from choosing a venue to managing your guests. No matter what your style, we can make the most of it
and help you celebrate in style.

[Contact Us Today][33]

## [Family Vacations][34]

Even though we specialize in romance travel, our clients usually stay with us for life – and that
means providing them with the same level of service, care, and creativity when it comes to family
travel. We’ve got a world of options and opportunities to create an experience that will provide
lifelong memories for all.

[Contact Us Today][35]

### Beach Travel has been creating incredible beach vacation & romance travel packages for over 25
### years.

We specialize in Beach Vacations, Romance Vacations, Destination Weddings, Vow Renewals, Honeymoons,
Family Travel and Group Travel. We have worked with thousands of people to make their beach &
romance travel dreams come true.

Deciding which of the innumerable websites to use to plan your travels can leave your head spinning,
especially if you aren’t an expert on that destination.

**We’re here because we are experts on the destinations that travelers seek out the most when they
want to plan their next getaway or special event. So you can relax and enjoy the entire experience
from beginning to end, knowing you’re in the best possible care.**

# Why Do Our Clients Continue to Book with Us Year After Year?
* We are your travel experts. We know what you don’t have time to research and remember.
* We serve as an impartial voice in a sea of confusing and conflicting online reviews.
* We are not your parents’ travel agents – we are modern experts with a fresh approach.
* We have a completely different take on vacation planning that puts your needs first.
* We are Certified Destination Wedding and Honeymoon Specialists for all, including LGBT+

## Hotels & Resorts

Kuala Lumpur
[Kuala Lumpur]
Malaysia vibrant capital – Kuala Lumpur is packed with historic monuments, steel-clad skyscrapers,
lush parks, mega-sized shopping malls, bustling street markets, trendy nightspots, and famous
hawker-type eateries. With abundance of thrills and delights everywhere to be discovered, embark on
an exciting city adventure without a moment to spare
[explore][99]
Johor Bahru
[Johor Bahru]
Johor Bahru, the southernmost state in Malaysia, is a vibrant city neighbouring Singapore. It boasts
integrated developments and tourist attractions, including Legoland Malaysia and Puteri Harbour.
This bustling metropolis also serves as a thriving commercial hub and a popular stopover for
travellers commuting between Malaysia and Singapore.
[explore][100]
Penang
[Penang]
Experience a harmonious blend of tradition, modernity, and nature in Penang. Known as the ‘Pearl of
the Orient’ and hailed as the food capital of Malaysia, this enchanting island destination entices
travellers with its rich heritage, stunning coastlines, and mouth-watering street food. Wander
through the streets of George Town, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage site, and discover wonders
at every turn.
[explore][101]
Langkawi
[Langkawi]
Langkawi, often referred to as the ‘Jewel of Kedah’, comprises an archipelago of 99 islands. In
2007, this legendary destination earned the UNESCO Global Geopark status. From ancient rock
formations to a treasure trove of flora and fauna, the Langkawi Geopark experience is an absolute
must for nature enthusiasts. Langkawi is also a duty-free island – the perfect retreat for savvy
shoppers.
[explore][102]
Tioman
[Tioman]
Nestled in the South China Sea, Tioman Island boasts breathtaking mountains, pristine beaches, and a
marine environment of unparalleled beauty. Teeming with vibrant coral reefs, this tropical haven has
rightfully earned its status as one of the world’s top diving destinations, offering exhilarating
underwater adventures. Whether you're a nature lover or a thrill seeker, Tioman Island guarantees an
unforgettable getaway.
[explore][103]
Redang
[Redang]
Redang Island is situated in the state of Terengganu on the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia.
Befitting the beauty of the island, Redang Island Resort marks its glimmering presence in Teluk
Siang, south of the island. Its expansive bay with azure waters is a wonderful place for leisure
activities and rejuvenating retreats.
[explore][104]
Bukit Tinggi
[Bukit Tinggi]
Set amidst lush tropical rainforest at an elevation of 2,500 feet above sea level in Pahang, the
Bukit Tinggi highlands provide pleasant breaks and refreshing retreats, particularly from the
year-round hot and humid climate in Malaysia. Here, you can rejuvenate with a serene stay in
picturesque hill resorts and experience exciting outdoor activities for a unique getaway.
[explore][105]
Manila
[Manila]
Discover Makati, a city in the Metro Manila region of the Philippines and the country’s financial
hub. While widely known as a bustling metropolis, it offers a diverse range of experiences. Explore
famous landmarks, upscale shopping malls, innovative galleries, and artisan markets. Experience the
rich Filipino culture and embrace the authentic essence of this vibrant destination.
[explore][106]
Colombo
[Colombo]
Colombo is a must-visit destination in Sri Lanka, boasting a rich history spanning over 2,000 years,
natural splendour, and cultural diversity. While in Colombo, discover the city’s rich heritage
through its historical landmarks and indulge in tantalizing Sri Lankan cuisine. Don’t miss the
opportunity to relax on nearby beaches, such as the popular Mount Lavinia Beach.
[explore][107]
Mahé
[Mahé]
In the western Indian Ocean, you'll find Mahé Island, the largest of the Seychelles archipelago.
Among Seychelles' longest beaches is Beau Vallon, popular for its breathtaking sceneries, abundant
recreational options, and excellent infrastructure. This pristine paradise, with its stunning shores
and crystal-clear waters, is an ideal destination for an island getaway, snorkelling and scuba
diving adventures.
[explore][108]
Praslin
[Praslin]
Experience the year-round tropical paradise of Praslin, the Seychelles' second largest island.
Showcasing natural beauty, Praslin captivates with its breathtaking beaches, emerald waters, and
lush jungles. Whether you're a beach enthusiast or a nature trail explorer, Praslin offers a myriad
of activities waiting to be discovered.
[explore][109]
London
[London]
Welcome to London, a vibrant city boasting some of the world's best sights, attractions, and
activities. Whether you're captivated by its lush parks, iconic landmarks, world-renowned museums,
or bustling shopping areas, this wonderful metropolis has something special in store for visitors of
all ages.
[explore][110]
Aomori
[Aomori]
Aomori, located in the Tohoku region, is one of Japan’s hidden treasures known for its seasonal
beauty. In winter months, the Hakkoda Mountains in Aomori are blanketed in snow, offering visitors
an opportunity to ski and snowboard among the ‘snow monsters’. The autumn foliage here is an
unforgettable sight. While during warmer months, you can trek through the lush greenery of Hakkoda
Mountains.
[explore][111]
Reykjavík
[Reykjavík]
Reykjavík, located in the southwestern region, is the capital and largest city of Iceland. There is
plenty to see and do, whether you come in summer or winter. Laugavegur is the main shopping, dining
and entertainment area. Around Reykjavík, you’ll discover many great places for sightseeing. Many
travellers stay in the city centre, but go on day tours to explore the surrounding areas.
[explore][112]
North Iceland
[North Iceland]
Discover the marvels of North Iceland by visiting Akureyri and Mývatn. Akureyri, known as the
‘Capital of the North’, is a vibrant town surrounded by breathtaking landscapes and serves as a
gateway to the magnificent attractions of Northern Iceland. As you venture eastward from Akureyri,
you'll find yourself in the enchanting region of Mývatn. It is known for its geothermal wonders,
presenting a truly extraordinary natural spectacle.
[explore][113]
East Iceland
[East Iceland]
East Iceland is a hidden gem waiting to be discovered. This region’s fascinating fjords with
meandering roads invite you to embark on drives, walks, and hikes to embrace its charm. Egilsstaðir,
the largest town in East Iceland, is famous for its natural beauty. It is an amazing place to visit
in both summer and winter—particularly favourable for outdoor activities such as reindeer spotting,
birdwatching, and hiking.
[explore][114]
South Iceland
[South Iceland]
The name Höfn means ‘harbour’ as the town is located in one of the few natural harbours of Iceland’s
South Coast. This destination is often visited by those embarking on the entire Ring Road of
Iceland, serving as a convenient stopover either before or after exploring the South Coast or East
Fjords. Steeped in history, Höfn has long been a vital trading and fishing port. It has gained
popularity for its fresh seafood, particularly the local lobster.
[explore][115]

## Discover your dream holiday with Berjaya Hotels & Resorts

Our hotels and resorts are situated in exciting holiday destinations around the world. Whether you
seek adventure, relaxation, or cultural exploration, you'll always find something unique to explore
and experience.

[View Destinations][96]

### Multicultural Malaysia

From stunning natural wonders to rich cultural heritage, Malaysia offers a diverse array of
attractions and experiences.

Sri Lanka awaits your discovery! Embrace nature and immerse yourself in its vibrant culture and

## Hotels & Resorts

Kuala Lumpur
[Kuala Lumpur]
Malaysia vibrant capital – Kuala Lumpur is packed with historic monuments, steel-clad skyscrapers,
lush parks, mega-sized shopping malls, bustling street markets, trendy nightspots, and famous
hawker-type eateries. With abundance of thrills and delights everywhere to be discovered, embark on
an exciting city adventure without a moment to spare
[explore][99]
Johor Bahru
[Johor Bahru]
Johor Bahru, the southernmost state in Malaysia, is a vibrant city neighbouring Singapore. It boasts
integrated developments and tourist attractions, including Legoland Malaysia and Puteri Harbour.
This bustling metropolis also serves as a thriving commercial hub and a popular stopover for
travellers commuting between Malaysia and Singapore.
[explore][100]
Penang
[Penang]
Experience a harmonious blend of tradition, modernity, and nature in Penang. Known as the ‘Pearl of
the Orient’ and hailed as the food capital of Malaysia, this enchanting island destination entices
travellers with its rich heritage, stunning coastlines, and mouth-watering street food. Wander
through the streets of George Town, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage site, and discover wonders
at every turn.
[explore][101]
Langkawi
[Langkawi]
Langkawi, often referred to as the ‘Jewel of Kedah’, comprises an archipelago of 99 islands. In
2007, this legendary destination earned the UNESCO Global Geopark status. From ancient rock
formations to a treasure trove of flora and fauna, the Langkawi Geopark experience is an absolute
must for nature enthusiasts. Langkawi is also a duty-free island – the perfect retreat for savvy
shoppers.
[explore][102]
Tioman
[Tioman]
Nestled in the South China Sea, Tioman Island boasts breathtaking mountains, pristine beaches, and a
marine environment of unparalleled beauty. Teeming with vibrant coral reefs, this tropical haven has
rightfully earned its status as one of the world’s top diving destinations, offering exhilarating
underwater adventures. Whether you're a nature lover or a thrill seeker, Tioman Island guarantees an
unforgettable getaway.
[explore][103]
Redang
[Redang]
Redang Island is situated in the state of Terengganu on the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia.
Befitting the beauty of the island, Redang Island Resort marks its glimmering presence in Teluk
Siang, south of the island. Its expansive bay with azure waters is a wonderful place for leisure
activities and rejuvenating retreats.
[explore][104]
Bukit Tinggi
[Bukit Tinggi]
Set amidst lush tropical rainforest at an elevation of 2,500 feet above sea level in Pahang, the
Bukit Tinggi highlands provide pleasant breaks and refreshing retreats, particularly from the
year-round hot and humid climate in Malaysia. Here, you can rejuvenate with a serene stay in
picturesque hill resorts and experience exciting outdoor activities for a unique getaway.
[explore][105]
Manila
[Manila]
Discover Makati, a city in the Metro Manila region of the Philippines and the country’s financial
hub. While widely known as a bustling metropolis, it offers a diverse range of experiences. Explore
famous landmarks, upscale shopping malls, innovative galleries, and artisan markets. Experience the
rich Filipino culture and embrace the authentic essence of this vibrant destination.
[explore][106]
Colombo
[Colombo]
Colombo is a must-visit destination in Sri Lanka, boasting a rich history spanning over 2,000 years,
natural splendour, and cultural diversity. While in Colombo, discover the city’s rich heritage
through its historical landmarks and indulge in tantalizing Sri Lankan cuisine. Don’t miss the
opportunity to relax on nearby beaches, such as the popular Mount Lavinia Beach.
[explore][107]
Mahé
[Mahé]
In the western Indian Ocean, you'll find Mahé Island, the largest of the Seychelles archipelago.
Among Seychelles' longest beaches is Beau Vallon, popular for its breathtaking sceneries, abundant
recreational options, and excellent infrastructure. This pristine paradise, with its stunning shores
and crystal-clear waters, is an ideal destination for an island getaway, snorkelling and scuba
diving adventures.
[explore][108]
Praslin
[Praslin]
Experience the year-round tropical paradise of Praslin, the Seychelles' second largest island.
Showcasing natural beauty, Praslin captivates with its breathtaking beaches, emerald waters, and
lush jungles. Whether you're a beach enthusiast or a nature trail explorer, Praslin offers a myriad
of activities waiting to be discovered.
[explore][109]
London
[London]
Welcome to London, a vibrant city boasting some of the world's best sights, attractions, and
activities. Whether you're captivated by its lush parks, iconic landmarks, world-renowned museums,
or bustling shopping areas, this wonderful metropolis has something special in store for visitors of
all ages.
[explore][110]
Aomori
[Aomori]
Aomori, located in the Tohoku region, is one of Japan’s hidden treasures known for its seasonal
beauty. In winter months, the Hakkoda Mountains in Aomori are blanketed in snow, offering visitors
an opportunity to ski and snowboard among the ‘snow monsters’. The autumn foliage here is an
unforgettable sight. While during warmer months, you can trek through the lush greenery of Hakkoda
Mountains.
[explore][111]
Reykjavík
[Reykjavík]
Reykjavík, located in the southwestern region, is the capital and largest city of Iceland. There is
plenty to see and do, whether you come in summer or winter. Laugavegur is the main shopping, dining
and entertainment area. Around Reykjavík, you’ll discover many great places for sightseeing. Many
travellers stay in the city centre, but go on day tours to explore the surrounding areas.
[explore][112]
North Iceland
[North Iceland]
Discover the marvels of North Iceland by visiting Akureyri and Mývatn. Akureyri, known as the
‘Capital of the North’, is a vibrant town surrounded by breathtaking landscapes and serves as a
gateway to the magnificent attractions of Northern Iceland. As you venture eastward from Akureyri,
you'll find yourself in the enchanting region of Mývatn. It is known for its geothermal wonders,
presenting a truly extraordinary natural spectacle.
[explore][113]
East Iceland
[East Iceland]
East Iceland is a hidden gem waiting to be discovered. This region’s fascinating fjords with
meandering roads invite you to embark on drives, walks, and hikes to embrace its charm. Egilsstaðir,
the largest town in East Iceland, is famous for its natural beauty. It is an amazing place to visit
in both summer and winter—particularly favourable for outdoor activities such as reindeer spotting,
birdwatching, and hiking.
[explore][114]
South Iceland
[South Iceland]
The name Höfn means ‘harbour’ as the town is located in one of the few natural harbours of Iceland’s
South Coast. This destination is often visited by those embarking on the entire Ring Road of
Iceland, serving as a convenient stopover either before or after exploring the South Coast or East
Fjords. Steeped in history, Höfn has long been a vital trading and fishing port. It has gained
popularity for its fresh seafood, particularly the local lobster.
[explore][115]

### [PRIVATE TOURS][63][[Private nature tour]][64]

We can organise a private tour for you and your group in and around Auckland and as far afield as
Rotorua, Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves With 42 years of experience we can arrange a private tour for
any size of group, from individuals, couples, families to large groups. If you are spending a few
days in Auckland we can arrange a varied itinerary for you over those days.

#### [Read more about our private tours][65]

## Why choose us?

We have been operating for 42 years and are the longest-running eco tour company in New Zealand. We
are a Net Carbon Zero certified company who have won many awards including Best Small Tourism
Company in New Zealand. Bush and Beach is a small family owned company who are leaders in
sustainable tourism and are proud of our sustainability commitment which you can find [here][66].
Some of the money from your booking goes straight back into local environmental initiatives.

With our small group tour sizes and knowledgeable and experienced guides you will have plenty of
opportunities to ask questions and find out what you want to know. We will look after you in our
small comfortable air conditioned vehicles with plenty of legroom.

Free Cancellation policy – You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the booked tour for a full
refund – [learn more][67]

Our office staff can help you with any [enquiries][68] you might have and help you choose the tour
that’s right for you. We will reconfirm all tours with you the day before so you don’t  have to
worry about pick up times.  Bush and Beach work closely with the Auckland hotels and offer **pick up
and drop offs from your Auckland City Centre hotel** for all of our Auckland day tours.

*“The guides were super friendly and informative. Everything ran like clockwork. Pick up and drop
off was easy.” Trip Advisor Review*

[[high-quality-vehicles]][69]

## Modern Vehicles

All of our vehicles are luxurious, modern and well maintained. Our vehicles have more leg room than
regular buses, easy access steps and plenty of storage space. Quiet interiors make it easy to talk
with your driver/guide who also has a great PA system.

[[city tour]][70]

## Flexible options

Having a [range of vehicles][71] gives us the flexibility to choose the most efficient and suitable
vehicle for each tour. Our smaller buses can often get to locations that larger buses can’t get to.
We have vehicles from 3 to 21 seats. For higher numbers we simply use more buses.

[Tour guide for guided tour to Piha beach from Auckland]

## Professional, friendly guides

All of our trained guides love looking after our guests. They love to share the stories and history
of NZ and look forward to helping you make the most of your time in and around Auckland.

## Qualmark Gold award holders

A Qualmark Gold Award recognises the best sustainable tourism businesses in New Zealand, with the
delivery of exceptional customer experiences an integral part of everything they do.  A Gold Award
identifies those businesses leading the way in making the New Zealand tourism industry a world class
sustainable visitor destination

[[TC_white_winner-gif_LL_2024]][72]

## Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Award

Bush and Beach hold the Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice for 2024 which is given to tour companies
that consistently earn great reviews from travellers and are ranked within the **top 10%** on [Trip
Advisor][73].

[Toitū_carbonzero_ISO14064-1 organisation_Black]

## Net Carbon Zero certified company

As part of our ongoing commitment to operating as sustainably as possible Bush and Beach achieved
the Toitū Net Carbon Zero  certification in April 2017. We are pleased to still be holding this
certification in 2026.

## 42 years of small group tour experience

Bush and Beach are celebrating running tours for 42 years, so when you book with us you know you are
booking with a company that has plenty of experience. The first tours we ran were our [Wilderness
Experience][74] tours to the black sand beach of Piha which still runs every afternoon.

[Sustainable Tourism in New Zealand]

## Helping the local environment

Every booking made with Bush and Beach helps the local environment. We use some of the money from
your booking to fund local [pest control][75] and also to [plant native plants][76] in our local
communities. To date we have planted 3,950 plants. When booking our tours you can opt to pay an
extra $6.50 which we match, meaning a native tree will get planted in Auckland through our [Trees
That Count][77] scheme. (Since starting in 2022 we have had 927 trees planted).

[[Bush and Beach]][78]

### [PRIVATE TOURS][63][[Private nature tour]][64]

We can organise a private tour for you and your group in and around Auckland and as far afield as
Rotorua, Hobbiton and Waitomo Caves With 42 years of experience we can arrange a private tour for
any size of group, from individuals, couples, families to large groups. If you are spending a few
days in Auckland we can arrange a varied itinerary for you over those days.

#### [Read more about our private tours][65]

## Why choose us?

We have been operating for 42 years and are the longest-running eco tour company in New Zealand. We
are a Net Carbon Zero certified company who have won many awards including Best Small Tourism
Company in New Zealand. Bush and Beach is a small family owned company who are leaders in
sustainable tourism and are proud of our sustainability commitment which you can find [here][66].
Some of the money from your booking goes straight back into local environmental initiatives.

With our small group tour sizes and knowledgeable and experienced guides you will have plenty of
opportunities to ask questions and find out what you want to know. We will look after you in our
small comfortable air conditioned vehicles with plenty of legroom.

Free Cancellation policy – You can cancel up to 24 hours in advance of the booked tour for a full
refund – [learn more][67]

Our office staff can help you with any [enquiries][68] you might have and help you choose the tour
that’s right for you. We will reconfirm all tours with you the day before so you don’t  have to
worry about pick up times.  Bush and Beach work closely with the Auckland hotels and offer **pick up
and drop offs from your Auckland City Centre hotel** for all of our Auckland day tours.

*“The guides were super friendly and informative. Everything ran like clockwork. Pick up and drop
off was easy.” Trip Advisor Review*

[[high-quality-vehicles]][69]

## Modern Vehicles

All of our vehicles are luxurious, modern and well maintained. Our vehicles have more leg room than
regular buses, easy access steps and plenty of storage space. Quiet interiors make it easy to talk
with your driver/guide who also has a great PA system.

[[city tour]][70]

## Flexible options

Having a [range of vehicles][71] gives us the flexibility to choose the most efficient and suitable
vehicle for each tour. Our smaller buses can often get to locations that larger buses can’t get to.
We have vehicles from 3 to 21 seats. For higher numbers we simply use more buses.

[Tour guide for guided tour to Piha beach from Auckland]

## Professional, friendly guides

All of our trained guides love looking after our guests. They love to share the stories and history
of NZ and look forward to helping you make the most of your time in and around Auckland.

## Qualmark Gold award holders

A Qualmark Gold Award recognises the best sustainable tourism businesses in New Zealand, with the
delivery of exceptional customer experiences an integral part of everything they do.  A Gold Award
identifies those businesses leading the way in making the New Zealand tourism industry a world class
sustainable visitor destination

[[TC_white_winner-gif_LL_2024]][72]

## Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Award

Bush and Beach hold the Tripadvisor Travellers’ Choice for 2024 which is given to tour companies
that consistently earn great reviews from travellers and are ranked within the **top 10%** on [Trip
Advisor][73].

[Toitū_carbonzero_ISO14064-1 organisation_Black]

## Net Carbon Zero certified company

As part of our ongoing commitment to operating as sustainably as possible Bush and Beach achieved
the Toitū Net Carbon Zero  certification in April 2017. We are pleased to still be holding this
certification in 2026.

## 42 years of small group tour experience

Bush and Beach are celebrating running tours for 42 years, so when you book with us you know you are
booking with a company that has plenty of experience. The first tours we ran were our [Wilderness
Experience][74] tours to the black sand beach of Piha which still runs every afternoon.

[Sustainable Tourism in New Zealand]

## Helping the local environment

Every booking made with Bush and Beach helps the local environment. We use some of the money from
your booking to fund local [pest control][75] and also to [plant native plants][76] in our local
communities. To date we have planted 3,950 plants. When booking our tours you can opt to pay an
extra $6.50 which we match, meaning a native tree will get planted in Auckland through our [Trees
That Count][77] scheme. (Since starting in 2022 we have had 927 trees planted).

[[Bush and Beach]][78]

### IRCTC

IRCTC stands for Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation. It is a subsidiary of Indian
Railways and is responsible for online ticket booking, catering, and tourism services. IRCTC was
established in 1999 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

IRCTC's online ticketing platform, called the IRCTC Next Generation e-Ticketing System, allows users
to book train tickets, check train availability, and track the status of their bookings. The
platform has also introduced various features such as e-wallets, cancellation and refund facilities,
and the option to book meals and accommodation on trains.

Apart from ticketing services, IRCTC also offers catering services to passengers through its
e-catering services. Passengers can pre-book meals and have them delivered to their seats during
their train journey. IRCTC also manages a chain of restaurants under the brand name "Food Plaza" and
"Jan Aahar" across various railway stations in India.

IRCTC also provides tourism services through its website, offering various tour packages and hotel
bookings for destinations across India. The corporation has also introduced various luxury trains,
such as the Maharaja Express and the Buddhist Circuit Tourist Train, which offer a unique travel
experience to passengers

ConfirmTkt is an authorised partner of IRCTC and IRCTC has its App as IRCTC Rail Connect

### IRCTC Booking Types:

#### IRCTC UTS (Unreserved ticketing system)

IRCTC UTS is a very handy mobile application, through which you can reserve paperless tickets. With
the app on your smartphone, you need not visit the ticket booking counter. One can also get a hard
copy of the ticket booked through the UTS app through ATVMs (automatic ticket vending machines). The
app also runs in an offline mode, through which you can book a ticket, even if you do not have an
internet connection. People buying tickets through the app can pay through the R-wallet (Railway
wallet).

##### IRCTC Full Tariff Rate (FTR)

At times, people need to book an entire coach or train for occasions like tours and parties. The FTR
(Full Tariff Rate) feature of IRCTC enables one to make such bookings. To avail discounts on FTR
bookings and enjoy a hassle-free process, you can use our platform for reserving the tickets. You
can register in advance (maximum of 6 months, minimum 30 days). A security deposit of INR 50, 000
has to be paid for each coach. If you are booking a special train, you need to book at least 18
coaches. To enjoy a hassle-free booking process at an affordable price, make sure to reserve the
ticket with us.

##### IRCTC General booking

You can find the IRCTC General Booking option on our website. The key feature of this type of
booking is that one can postpone or prepone the date of journey. You can get
Waitlisted/RAC/Confirmed tickets postponed or preponed with an extra charge on a higher class, or
the same class. For waitlisted and RAC tickets, this feature is available once per user for a
specific booking. We bring you all the necessary features and assistance in adjusting the dates of
your ride.

### How does Juniper’s technology help connect with OTAs, tour operators, and traditional agencies?

Juniper Booking Engine integrates multiple distribution channels into a single platform. It includes
channels such as B2B2C and B2C websites, multilingual white labels, trip planner, call centers,
mobile points of sale, and XML Webservice connections, benefiting both digital and traditional
sales.

### What is multichannel distribution in tourism and why is it key for businesses?

Multichannel distribution in tourism consists of offering and managing travel products (such as

and offline. This type of distribution not only expands market reach but also increases revenue and

Juniper Booking Engine integrates multiple distribution channels into a single platform. It includes
channels such as B2B2C and B2C websites, multilingual white labels, trip planner, call centers,
mobile points of sale, and XML Webservice connections, benefiting both digital and traditional
sales.

### What is multichannel distribution in tourism and why is it key for businesses?

and offline. This type of distribution not only expands market reach but also increases revenue and

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and

accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location

to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate

## will be nothing short of unforgettable.
##  

## "Welcome to the dream, Welcome to Italia"

Discover Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily: three extraordinary destinations where the sea meets
history, authentic flavors, and dreamlike landscapes. From pristine beaches to crystal-clear waters,
from charming villages to the most authentic traditions, every corner of Italy offers unique
emotions and unforgettable moments. Let yourself be captivated by the warmth of hospitality, the
aromas of Mediterranean cuisine, and the magic of timeless lands. Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily
await you for an authentic, intense, and surprising experience.

[Blue Flags 2026]

### Blue Flags 2026

The 2026 Blue Flags confirm Italy as one of the most popular seaside destinations in Europe. The
award, presented by the FEE – Foundation for Environmental Education – each year recognises
locations that stand out for water quality, environmental sustainability, tourist services and land
management. This year, the number of award-winning municipalities has risen to 257, with 525
recognised beaches and 87 certified tourist marinas. The 2026 Blue Flags are an important guide for
those who want to choose seaside resorts with clean sea, efficient services and attention to the
environment. Every year, thousands of Italian and foreign tourists consult the official list of
award-winning beaches to plan their summer holidays and discover the best seaside destinations in
Italy.
2 minutes
][148]
[
Cycling tourism Like
[alla scoperta della ciclovia in abruzzo]

### Discovering Italy’s most beautiful “Bike to Coast” bike route in Abruzzo

Abruzzo is one of Italy’s most bike friendly regions, brimming with cycle paths and routes to
discover on your road or mountain bike, through beaches, protected nature, small villages, castles
and abbeys. All of Abruzzo's seaside resorts are connected by a cycle path that makes it very easy
to explore the area, travelling from one municipality by simply hopping on your bike. What if we
told you that you could ride your bike along the entire Abruzzo coast? It’s true! All thanks to Bike
To Coast Abruzzo, a 131-kilometre-long cycle path that starts in Martinsicuro, in the province of
Teramo on the border with the Le Marche province of Ascoli Piceno, and reaches as far as San Salvo,
on the border with Molise. This extensive route, which you can tackle in stages or even in one go
for the more experienced cyclists, runs along the Green Adriatic Corridor through 19 municipalities
and some of Italy's most beautiful beaches. Among clean beaches and shallow waters, shaded pine
forests and medieval villages, are you ready to discover the wonders of Abruzzo on two wheels?
4 minutes

[Basilicata coast to coast: the perfect way to discover the region]

### Basilicata coast to coast: the perfect way to discover the region

There is a famous Italian film called Basilicata coast to coast. Be inspired by the director and
star of this brilliant comedy, Rocco Papaleo, on your own tour of Basilicata that takes you from the
rocky coast of the Tyrrhenian Sea to the dunes of the Ionian coast. Alongside the best-known
locations, you will discover secret places on a fascinating route that takes you from mountains and
hills to lakes and beaches; from arid gorges to lush forests. On foot, by bike, by car or a
combination of all three: you choose the best way for your coast-to-coast tour of authentic
Basilicata.

### The enchanting crystalline sea of the Zagare Bay in the Gargano district

This location, in the northern part of the Apulia region, is situated on the Gargano promontory (the
“spur” of the Italic pensinsula) extending out into the Adriatic Sea. The bay is characterised by
crystal clear waters , the purity of which has been recognised by the Italian Legambiente
environmentalist association, which awarded it a “3-sail” rating.

### Piedmont: a mountain of experiences

If you are planning a trip, a weekend or a stay dedicated to adventure and well-being, Piedmont can
surprise you with proposals designed to meet the needs of those travelling alone or with family, as
a couple or with friends. Here, the mountains are truly for everyone, hospitable and welcoming in
the network of mountain huts, hotels, B&Bs and farmhouses, where you can enjoy the beneficial
effects of nature, among the slow treasures of the Alpine valleys, food and wine, art and events in
villages and locations rich in art, history and community, but also regenerating forest bathing and
spa treatments. Fun and discovery are the ingredients of extraordinary biodiversity on 20,000 km of
cycling and hiking trails, the 70 stages of the Sentiero Italia C.A.I. in the Piedmont Alps, 2
National Parks (Gran Paradiso and Val Grande), 77 protected areas, 3 UNESCO MaB Biosphere Reserves,
alongside a myriad of activities: from climbing to horse riding, from via ferratas to Nordic
walking, water and air sports, while the magnificent scenery is the perfect subject for lovers of
nature photography and wildlife watching. And in winter, 1,300 km of slopes and 50 snow resorts in a
natural habitat of diverse itineraries and routes are an irresistible call to have fun safely with
downhill and cross-country skiing, snowshoeing and ski mountaineering, tobogganing and snowboarding,
ice climbing and dog sledding.

## will be nothing short of unforgettable.
##  

## "Welcome to the dream, Welcome to Italia"

Discover Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily: three extraordinary destinations where the sea meets
history, authentic flavors, and dreamlike landscapes. From pristine beaches to crystal-clear waters,
from charming villages to the most authentic traditions, every corner of Italy offers unique
emotions and unforgettable moments. Let yourself be captivated by the warmth of hospitality, the
aromas of Mediterranean cuisine, and the magic of timeless lands. Calabria, Sardinia, and Sicily
await you for an authentic, intense, and surprising experience.

[Blue Flags 2026]

### Blue Flags 2026

The 2026 Blue Flags confirm Italy as one of the most popular seaside destinations in Europe. The
award, presented by the FEE – Foundation for Environmental Education – each year recognises
locations that stand out for water quality, environmental sustainability, tourist services and land
management. This year, the number of award-winning municipalities has risen to 257, with 525
recognised beaches and 87 certified tourist marinas. The 2026 Blue Flags are an important guide for
those who want to choose seaside resorts with clean sea, efficient services and attention to the
environment. Every year, thousands of Italian and foreign tourists consult the official list of
award-winning beaches to plan their summer holidays and discover the best seaside destinations in
Italy.
2 minutes
][148]
[
Cycling tourism Like
[alla scoperta della ciclovia in abruzzo]

### Discovering Italy’s most beautiful “Bike to Coast” bike route in Abruzzo

Abruzzo is one of Italy’s most bike friendly regions, brimming with cycle paths and routes to
discover on your road or mountain bike, through beaches, protected nature, small villages, castles
and abbeys. All of Abruzzo's seaside resorts are connected by a cycle path that makes it very easy
to explore the area, travelling from one municipality by simply hopping on your bike. What if we
told you that you could ride your bike along the entire Abruzzo coast? It’s true! All thanks to Bike
To Coast Abruzzo, a 131-kilometre-long cycle path that starts in Martinsicuro, in the province of
Teramo on the border with the Le Marche province of Ascoli Piceno, and reaches as far as San Salvo,
on the border with Molise. This extensive route, which you can tackle in stages or even in one go
for the more experienced cyclists, runs along the Green Adriatic Corridor through 19 municipalities
and some of Italy's most beautiful beaches. Among clean beaches and shallow waters, shaded pine
forests and medieval villages, are you ready to discover the wonders of Abruzzo on two wheels?
4 minutes
][149]
[
Art and culture Like
[Basilicata coast to coast: the perfect way to discover the region]

### Basilicata coast to coast: the perfect way to discover the region

There is a famous Italian film called Basilicata coast to coast. Be inspired by the director and
star of this brilliant comedy, Rocco Papaleo, on your own tour of Basilicata that takes you from the
rocky coast of the Tyrrhenian Sea to the dunes of the Ionian coast. Alongside the best-known
locations, you will discover secret places on a fascinating route that takes you from mountains and
hills to lakes and beaches; from arid gorges to lush forests. On foot, by bike, by car or a
combination of all three: you choose the best way for your coast-to-coast tour of authentic
Basilicata.
4 minutes

[464451044]

### The enchanting crystalline sea of the Zagare Bay in the Gargano district

This location, in the northern part of the Apulia region, is situated on the Gargano promontory (the
“spur” of the Italic pensinsula) extending out into the Adriatic Sea. The bay is characterised by
crystal clear waters , the purity of which has been recognised by the Italian Legambiente
environmentalist association, which awarded it a “3-sail” rating.

[
Mountain Like
[945124376]

### Piedmont: a mountain of experiences

If you are planning a trip, a weekend or a stay dedicated to adventure and well-being, Piedmont can
surprise you with proposals designed to meet the needs of those travelling alone or with family, as
a couple or with friends. Here, the mountains are truly for everyone, hospitable and welcoming in
the network of mountain huts, hotels, B&Bs and farmhouses, where you can enjoy the beneficial
effects of nature, among the slow treasures of the Alpine valleys, food and wine, art and events in
villages and locations rich in art, history and community, but also regenerating forest bathing and
spa treatments. Fun and discovery are the ingredients of extraordinary biodiversity on 20,000 km of
cycling and hiking trails, the 70 stages of the Sentiero Italia C.A.I. in the Piedmont Alps, 2
National Parks (Gran Paradiso and Val Grande), 77 protected areas, 3 UNESCO MaB Biosphere Reserves,
alongside a myriad of activities: from climbing to horse riding, from via ferratas to Nordic
walking, water and air sports, while the magnificent scenery is the perfect subject for lovers of
nature photography and wildlife watching. And in winter, 1,300 km of slopes and 50 snow resorts in a
natural habitat of diverse itineraries and routes are an irresistible call to have fun safely with
downhill and cross-country skiing, snowshoeing and ski mountaineering, tobogganing and snowboarding,
ice climbing and dog sledding.

# Katathani Phuket Beach Resort

Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand

Welcome to Katathani Phuket Beach Resort, a deluxe beachfront sanctuary set along an 850-meter
stretch of pristine white sand on Kata Noi Beach, Phuket, Thailand. Nestled where lush green hills
gracefully embrace the sparkling blue ocean, the resort radiates tranquility and natural
beauty-perfectly embodying the spirit of Phuket.

Designed to ensure your perfect experience, the resort offers distinct wings tailored to every
traveler - whether you're venturing solo, seeking a romantic escape, or planning a family getaway.
This exquisite Phuket retreat provides everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Immerse
yourself in world-class amenities, rejuvenate with soothing spa treatments, and savor exquisite
dining options, all while basking in the serene allure of Phuket’s most idyllic settings along a
stunning public beach.

Vhari Wing Bhuri Wing

# [Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa][16]

**Welcome to Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa**

Surround yourself with nature and at this tranquil retreat in north Phuket and appreciate the real
beauty of this paradise island away from the bustling tourist crowds. Situated on the fringes of
Sirinat National Park there is an abundance of greenery area, and the beautiful beach with gently
sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

[Learn more][17]

# [Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa][16]

**Welcome to Nai Yang Beach Resort and Spa**

Surround yourself with nature and at this tranquil retreat in north Phuket and appreciate the real
beauty of this paradise island away from the bustling tourist crowds. Situated on the fringes of
Sirinat National Park there is an abundance of greenery area, and the beautiful beach with gently
sloping white sand is just a few steps away.

**Nai Yang Beach Resort** is located in a quiet bay on the northwest coast of Phuket Island. Guests
can enjoy comfortable rooms, a spa center, and an outdoor swimming pool. The rooms offer beautiful
views of the tropical landscape. Free parking is available for guests.

Nai Yang Beach Resort is only 1 km from Phuket International Airport. It takes no more than 5
minutes to walk to the sandy beaches.

The rooms at Nai Yang Resort are decorated in a modern style and equipped with air conditioning.
Each room has a private balcony overlooking the lush garden and the pool. Other standard amenities
include tea/coffee making facilities and a cable TV.

The tour desk can assist guests in booking one-day island excursions. Laundry services are also
available.

At **Turtle Bay Restaurant**, guests can enjoy a buffet breakfast featuring international cuisine,
while **The Sand Restaurant** offers a variety of Thai and Western dishes.

[Learn more][17]

## FROM TIMES SQUARE TO THE WORLD

Our video series follows New Yorkers around the boroughs as they uncover NYC's groundbreaking
cultural movements, creative cuisines and revolutionary ideas—starting right from Times Square. See
the trailer below, and

[**watch the full series here**][7]

## ABOUT THE FIVE BOROUGHS

[EXPLORE THE BOROUGHS][8]

So what’s a “borough,” anyway? It’s like a smaller city within our massive metropolis. New York City
has five of them.

### Staten Island

New York City’s southernmost borough is filled with historic attractions, beach views and global
dining options—all just a ferry ride away.

[View Borough][9]

### The Bronx

The Bronx is packed with New York City history and culture. It’s where Babe Ruth became a baseball
legend, where the sounds and styles of hip-hop were born and where you can feast on old-world
classics in its own Little Italy.

[View Borough][10]

### Brooklyn

Between its world-class nightlife and boundary-pushing cuisine, Brooklyn has earned an enviable
reputation, but make no mistake—there's fun to be had for all ages.

[View Borough][11]

### Manhattan

From the bright lights of Broadway to the soaring elms of Central Park and beyond, Manhattan is an
American icon. With the most recognizable skyline in the world, NYC’s most visited borough is full
of excitement for every kind of adventurer.

[View Borough][12]

### Queens

Queens can satisfy nearly every taste and thrill. From an endless selection of old-world cuisines to
the scenic surf, it’s easy to explore the entire world in one trip around this borough.

# Home

## We’re On the Beach

On the Beach Group plc is one of the UK’s largest online package holiday specialists. We offer
choice, value, flexibility and financial protection, powered by our proprietary technology platform.

With an asset-light, cash-generative model, we drive customer acquisition and loyalty through
scalable technology, automation and operational efficiency, enabling us to grow profitably while
helping more people holiday better and more often.

Renowned for beach package holidays, we have leveraged our expertise, technology and strong supplier
relationships to broaden our addressable market, expanding into city breaks and cruise holidays, and
offering our full range of holidays to customers in the Republic of Ireland.

# Beachfront Resort in St. Pete Beach, Florida

Welcome to Plaza Beach Resorts, an award-winning resort collection in St. Pete Beach, Florida.
Featuring one beachfront resort and two waterfront resorts, our properties offer comfortable
accommodations and the unique benefit of shared amenities across all three resorts. Whether you're
planning a family vacation, romantic getaway, or relaxing Florida Gulf Coast escape, experience St.
Pete Beach with us.

## ExploreOurResorts

 Discover Plaza Beach Resorts' collection of award-winning properties featuring one beachfront
resort and two waterfront resorts in St. Pete Beach. Stay directly on the Gulf Coast at Plaza Beach
Hotel – Beachfront Resort, or enjoy a relaxing waterfront setting at Bayview Plaza Waterfront Resort
& Marina and Bay Palms Waterfront Resort & Marina. Each boutique property offers its own unique
experience, comfortable accommodations, and convenient access to St. Pete Beach. Explore our three
resorts and choose the beachfront or waterfront stay that best matches your Florida Gulf Coast
vacation.

## PULLMAN DANANG BEACH RESORT

 




##### Pullman Danang Beach Resort is part of Accor, a world-leading augmented hospitality group
##### offering unique experiences in more than 5,000 hotels & residences across 110 countries.

 

Central Vietnam’s silver shores provide seaside fun for your holiday. And the up-and-coming city of
Da Nang is your urban playground, just waiting to be explored. On the stunning white sands of Bac My
An Beach, **Pullman Danang Beach Resort** is a vibrant oasis of activity & relaxation. Distinctive
cuisine & creative beverage concepts are Pullman hallmarks.

### IDYLLIC LOCATION

 


Set on the white sands of Bac My An Beach, overlooking the azure waters of the East Sea, **Pullman
Danang Beach Resort** is the ultimate tropical paradise. Only 15 minutes from Danang International
Airport & the city center, and just a short drive from world-class golf courses, our premium resort
is perfectly positioned for all types of travelers. With several UNESCO World Heritage sites on its
doorstep, Pullman Danang Beach Resort is the ideal start to explore the region’s abundance of
natural beauty & cultural significance.

### **ELEGANTLY APPOINTED ROOMS & CREATIVE CULINARY CONCEPTS**

 

**Pullman Danang Beach Resort** features 186 elegantly appointed guest [**rooms & cottages**][63],
all with private balconies overlooking the beach, infinity pool, or tropical gardens.

Combining Pullman’s global expertise with Vietnam’s rich culinary heritage, **Pullman Danang Beach
Resort** serves an enticing array of food & beverage concepts. Sample Vietnamese & international
delights at [**Epice Restaurant**][64], exotic Asian specialties & refreshing cocktails at the
[**Infinity Bar**][65] & the freshest local seafood on the beach at [**Azure Beach Lounge**][66].

### **KEEPING FIT & ACTIVE**

 

Offering a wide variety of daily activities, **Pullman Danang Beach Resort** allows you to stay
active & entertained throughout your stay. From [**creative classes**][67] that connect you & your
family with local culture to **[exciting games & sports][68]** that keep you fit & active, our goal
is to deliver a fun & memorable vacation experience.

### **REJUVENATION & WELL-BEING**

 

Overlooking our serene tropical gardens, [**The Nắng Spa**][69] is the perfect place to unwind &
indulge your senses. Enjoy a wide range of body treatments at [**The Nắng **][70]**Spa**, or work
off your tension at our fully equipped [**Fit Lounge.**][71]

### **MEET & PLAY**

 

With a diverse range of [**venues**][72], the latest audiovisual technology & professional staff,
**Pullman Danang Beach Resort** ensures that every event runs smoothly & seamlessly. With space for
up to 900 delegates, our resort is perfect for all types of functions, from intimate social
gatherings to board meetings, themed events, beachfront weddings, cocktail parties & more.

Extensive event facilities and Pullman’s unique business services make the resort the ideal choice
for your next incentive getaway. When romance is in the air, the Grand Ballroom & private beach are
fairy-tale venues for [**your dream wedding**][73].

##### About Rassada Pier

**Rassada Pier** is a passenger pier located in [ Rassada Subdistrict][13], [Mueang Phuket
District][14] [ Phuket Province.][15] It serves as a central hub for ferry services,
[speedboats][16], and [ferries][17] connecting the main island of Phuket with various islands in the
[ Andaman Sea ][18], such as [Phi Phi Islands][19], [Koh Lanta ][20], [Ao Nang ][21], [Koh
Lipe][22], and other islands.
