### 🤝 Concession and Management

In 2001, the [Phuket Provincial Administrative Organization][23] granted a 30-year concession to
**[Sea Tran Travel Company Limited][24] ** to manage, operate, and develop the facilities at Rassada
Pier. During that period, usage increased significantly to improve operational efficiency, enhance
safety standards, and improve services for tourists. The concession will expire in 2031, after which
it will be reviewed or extended based on operational results and public policy.

[Location view]

## 📜 History

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2001–2002: Initial Development

Local authorities collaborated with ferry operators to officially develop the area into a pier.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Construction of concrete piers, passenger buildings, and the start of ferry services to [Phi Phi
Islands ][25] and other islands.

#### 2010–2015: Tourism Integration

Rassada Pier was incorporated into tour packages and travel connections with hotels, with route
expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

#### 2016–2019: Technology and Management

Introduction of computerized ticketing systems and more systematic transportation management.

#### 2020–2021: COVID-19 Impact

The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in the suspension of most ferry services, with tourist numbers
dramatically declining.

#### 2022–Present: Recovery

After the country reopened, Rassada Pier resumed normal operations with minor repairs and
improvements to infrastructure, continuing to serve as Phuket's main transportation hub.

## 🏛️ Administration and Management

[ Rassada Pier][28] is located in [Rassada Subdistrict][29], one of eight subdistricts in [Mueang
Phuket District][30], Phuket Province, Thailand. Rassada Subdistrict has the status of a subdistrict
municipality, which performs local administrative functions within the framework of Phuket Province.

The pier is under the responsibility of the **[Rassada Subdistrict Administrative
Organization][31]**, which oversees infrastructure, cleanliness, and community development in the
area. Although some pier operations and maintenance are the responsibility of private ferry
companies, facilities and connecting roads remain under joint supervision with local authorities.

### Supervising Agencies

Due to its economic and tourism importance, the pier is supervised by provincial tourism and
transportation agencies, including:
* **[Phuket Harbor Office][32]**
* **[Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)][33]** - Phuket Office
* **[Phuket Provincial Land Transport Office][34]**

## 🏗️ Pier Components

### 🅿️ Parking Area

Rassada Pier has parking systems for both cars and motorcycles, offering daily and overnight
parking. Services include both open-air and covered parking with adequate space for users.

##### About Rassada Pier

**Rassada Pier** is a passenger pier located in [ Rassada Subdistrict][13], [Mueang Phuket
District][14] [ Phuket Province.][15] It serves as a central hub for ferry services,
[speedboats][16], and [ferries][17] connecting the main island of Phuket with various islands in the
[ Andaman Sea ][18], such as [Phi Phi Islands][19], [Koh Lanta ][20], [Ao Nang ][21], [Koh
Lipe][22], and other islands.

Map of Rassada pier, 2006

───────────────┬─────────────
**Country**    │Thailand     
───────────────┼─────────────
**Province**   │Phuket       
───────────────┼─────────────
**District**   │Mueang Phuket
───────────────┼─────────────
**Subdistrict**│Rassada      
───────────────┴─────────────

### 🤝 Concession and Management

In 2001, the [Phuket Provincial Administrative Organization][23] granted a 30-year concession to
**[Sea Tran Travel Company Limited][24] ** to manage, operate, and develop the facilities at Rassada
Pier. During that period, usage increased significantly to improve operational efficiency, enhance
safety standards, and improve services for tourists. The concession will expire in 2031, after which
it will be reviewed or extended based on operational results and public policy.

[Location view]

## 📜 History

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2001–2002: Initial Development

Local authorities collaborated with ferry operators to officially develop the area into a pier.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Construction of concrete piers, passenger buildings, and the start of ferry services to [Phi Phi
Islands ][25] and other islands.

#### 2010–2015: Tourism Integration

Rassada Pier was incorporated into tour packages and travel connections with hotels, with route
expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

#### 2016–2019: Technology and Management

Introduction of computerized ticketing systems and more systematic transportation management.

#### 2020–2021: COVID-19 Impact

The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in the suspension of most ferry services, with tourist numbers
dramatically declining.

#### 2022–Present: Recovery

After the country reopened, Rassada Pier resumed normal operations with minor repairs and
improvements to infrastructure, continuing to serve as Phuket's main transportation hub.

## 🏛️ Administration and Management

[ Rassada Pier][28] is located in [Rassada Subdistrict][29], one of eight subdistricts in [Mueang
Phuket District][30], Phuket Province, Thailand. Rassada Subdistrict has the status of a subdistrict
municipality, which performs local administrative functions within the framework of Phuket Province.

The pier is under the responsibility of the **[Rassada Subdistrict Administrative
Organization][31]**, which oversees infrastructure, cleanliness, and community development in the
area. Although some pier operations and maintenance are the responsibility of private ferry
companies, facilities and connecting roads remain under joint supervision with local authorities.

### Supervising Agencies

Due to its economic and tourism importance, the pier is supervised by provincial tourism and
transportation agencies, including:
* **[Phuket Harbor Office][32]**
* **[Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)][33]** - Phuket Office
* **[Phuket Provincial Land Transport Office][34]**

## 🏗️ Pier Components

### 🅿️ Parking Area

Rassada Pier has parking systems for both cars and motorcycles, offering daily and overnight
parking. Services include both open-air and covered parking with adequate space for users.

### 🚐 Pick-up/Drop-off Point

The pier has designated areas for tourist vans, taxis, and private cars for convenient passenger
pick-up and drop-off.

### 🚕 Common Transportation Methods
* **[Taxi][35]** – Easily found in Phuket, suitable for busy periods, but should be booked in
  advance during high tourist season.
* **[Vans][36]** – Arranged by hotels or tour companies, often included in ferry packages.
* **[Motorcycle Taxis][37]** – Suitable for short trips, such as from downtown or nearby hotels.
* **[Songthaew (Two-rows)][38]** – A cost-effective alternative but takes longer.
* **[PPA Smart Bus][39]** – An economical option, but this bus operates only during certain hours.

## 🌊 Popular Destinations

Rassada Pier serves as the main departure point for ferries to:
* [Phi Phi Islands][40]
* [Koh Lanta][41]
* [Railay Beach (Ao Nang)][42]
* [Koh Lipe][43]
* Other Andaman Sea islands

##### Map & Directions

###### How to get here:
* **By Car:** Use GPS and search for "Rassada Pier". Parking is available on-site.
* **By Public Transport:** Take a local taxi or minivan from Phuket Town (about 15 minutes).
* **By Bus:** From Phuket Bus Terminal, you can take a tuk-tuk or taxi directly.

In 2001, the [Phuket Provincial Administrative Organization][23] granted a 30-year concession to
**[Sea Tran Travel Company Limited][24] ** to manage, operate, and develop the facilities at Rassada
Pier. During that period, usage increased significantly to improve operational efficiency, enhance
safety standards, and improve services for tourists. The concession will expire in 2031, after which
it will be reviewed or extended based on operational results and public policy.

[Location view]

## 📜 History

#### Before 2000: Local Boat Dock

Before developing into a maritime transportation hub, Rassada Pier was merely a small dock used for
fishing boats and local cargo vessels. The area was just an ordinary coastline with minimal
infrastructure, supporting fishermen and traders between islands.

#### 2001–2002: Initial Development

Local authorities collaborated with ferry operators to officially develop the area into a pier.

#### 2005–2010: Expansion

Construction of concrete piers, passenger buildings, and the start of ferry services to [Phi Phi
Islands ][25] and other islands.

#### 2010–2015: Tourism Integration

Rassada Pier was incorporated into tour packages and travel connections with hotels, with route
expansions to [Koh Lanta][26] and [Railay Beach][27].

#### 2016–2019: Technology and Management

Introduction of computerized ticketing systems and more systematic transportation management.

#### 2020–2021: COVID-19 Impact

The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in the suspension of most ferry services, with tourist numbers
dramatically declining.

#### 2022–Present: Recovery

After the country reopened, Rassada Pier resumed normal operations with minor repairs and
improvements to infrastructure, continuing to serve as Phuket's main transportation hub.

## 🏛️ Administration and Management

[ Rassada Pier][28] is located in [Rassada Subdistrict][29], one of eight subdistricts in [Mueang
Phuket District][30], Phuket Province, Thailand. Rassada Subdistrict has the status of a subdistrict
municipality, which performs local administrative functions within the framework of Phuket Province.

The pier is under the responsibility of the **[Rassada Subdistrict Administrative
Organization][31]**, which oversees infrastructure, cleanliness, and community development in the
area. Although some pier operations and maintenance are the responsibility of private ferry
companies, facilities and connecting roads remain under joint supervision with local authorities.

### Supervising Agencies

Due to its economic and tourism importance, the pier is supervised by provincial tourism and
transportation agencies, including:
* **[Phuket Harbor Office][32]**
* **[Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT)][33]** - Phuket Office
* **[Phuket Provincial Land Transport Office][34]**

## 🏗️ Pier Components

### 🅿️ Parking Area

Rassada Pier has parking systems for both cars and motorcycles, offering daily and overnight
parking. Services include both open-air and covered parking with adequate space for users.

### 🚐 Pick-up/Drop-off Point

The pier has designated areas for tourist vans, taxis, and private cars for convenient passenger
pick-up and drop-off.

### 🚕 Common Transportation Methods
* **[Taxi][35]** – Easily found in Phuket, suitable for busy periods, but should be booked in
  advance during high tourist season.
* **[Vans][36]** – Arranged by hotels or tour companies, often included in ferry packages.
* **[Motorcycle Taxis][37]** – Suitable for short trips, such as from downtown or nearby hotels.
* **[Songthaew (Two-rows)][38]** – A cost-effective alternative but takes longer.
* **[PPA Smart Bus][39]** – An economical option, but this bus operates only during certain hours.

## 🌊 Popular Destinations

Rassada Pier serves as the main departure point for ferries to:
* [Phi Phi Islands][40]
* [Koh Lanta][41]
* [Railay Beach (Ao Nang)][42]
* [Koh Lipe][43]
* Other Andaman Sea islands

##### Map & Directions

###### How to get here:
* **By Car:** Use GPS and search for "Rassada Pier". Parking is available on-site.
* **By Public Transport:** Take a local taxi or minivan from Phuket Town (about 15 minutes).
* **By Bus:** From Phuket Bus Terminal, you can take a tuk-tuk or taxi directly.

4-star coastal luxury in Surfers Paradise with stunning ocean views

### Accommodation

Rhapsody Resort offers stylish self-contained accommodation in Surfers Paradise. Guests can choose
between studio, one, or two-bedroom apartments with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and city
skyline. Each apartment includes a full kitchen and laundry facilities for added convenience.

### Facilities

The hotel includes a rooftop garden terrace on Level 41, providing panoramic views of the Gold
Coast. A 20-metre heated outdoor swimming pool, spa, steam room, and sauna are available to guests
for relaxation. A fully equipped gym on Level 27 offers scenic views during workouts.

### Dining Options

The Rhapsody Beachside Café on the ground level serves organic fair trade coffee and a varied menu
featuring fresh seasonal dishes. Guests can enjoy casual dining just steps from Surfers Paradise
Beach. Outdoor BBQ facilities are available for guests wishing to cook and dine al fresco.

### Location

Situated just 100 metres from patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach, Rhapsody Resort is in close
proximity to local restaurants and retail options. The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the Gold
Coast and its many attractions, including theme parks and hidden beachfronts. Public transport is
easily accessible, enhancing convenience for guests.

### Event Spaces

The hotel offers two meeting rooms on Level 27, suitable for small corporate events and gatherings.
Both spaces feature modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi and adjoining balcony access with
ocean views. These rooms can accommodate groups ranging from 6 to 50 guests.

### Highlights

Location: 100 metres to Patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach

Wellness: heated outdoor pool, spa, sauna

Dining: Rhapsody Beachside Café

Event Spaces: meeting rooms on Level 27

Facilities: Level 41 Garden Rooftop Terrace

“Rhapsody Resort makes a striking impression with its rooftop garden terrace, set up for expansive
views that capture both the ocean and hinterland. The self-contained apartments have a stylish,
modern design, steps away from Surfers Paradise Beach; the on-site cafe sources organic and local
ingredients, a thoughtful touch. I especially appreciate the attention to detail in curating unique
local experiences for guests.”

4-star coastal luxury in Surfers Paradise with stunning ocean views

### Accommodation

Rhapsody Resort offers stylish self-contained accommodation in Surfers Paradise. Guests can choose
between studio, one, or two-bedroom apartments with breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and city
skyline. Each apartment includes a full kitchen and laundry facilities for added convenience.

### Facilities

The hotel includes a rooftop garden terrace on Level 41, providing panoramic views of the Gold
Coast. A 20-metre heated outdoor swimming pool, spa, steam room, and sauna are available to guests
for relaxation. A fully equipped gym on Level 27 offers scenic views during workouts.

### Dining Options

The Rhapsody Beachside Café on the ground level serves organic fair trade coffee and a varied menu
featuring fresh seasonal dishes. Guests can enjoy casual dining just steps from Surfers Paradise
Beach. Outdoor BBQ facilities are available for guests wishing to cook and dine al fresco.

### Location

Situated just 100 metres from patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach, Rhapsody Resort is in close
proximity to local restaurants and retail options. The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the Gold
Coast and its many attractions, including theme parks and hidden beachfronts. Public transport is
easily accessible, enhancing convenience for guests.

### Event Spaces

The hotel offers two meeting rooms on Level 27, suitable for small corporate events and gatherings.
Both spaces feature modern amenities, including high-speed Wi-Fi and adjoining balcony access with
ocean views. These rooms can accommodate groups ranging from 6 to 50 guests.

### Highlights

Location: 100 metres to Patrolled Surfers Paradise Beach

Wellness: heated outdoor pool, spa, sauna

Dining: Rhapsody Beachside Café

Event Spaces: meeting rooms on Level 27

Facilities: Level 41 Garden Rooftop Terrace

“Rhapsody Resort makes a striking impression with its rooftop garden terrace, set up for expansive
views that capture both the ocean and hinterland. The self-contained apartments have a stylish,
modern design, steps away from Surfers Paradise Beach; the on-site cafe sources organic and local
ingredients, a thoughtful touch. I especially appreciate the attention to detail in curating unique
local experiences for guests.”
[Hotel logo][Hotel logo]
Edward HayesEditor-in-Chief at Beachresort

# Welcome to San Juan, Puerto Rico
# 2026 Tourism Guide

[🇵🇷 Puerto Rico][72] ⎮ San Juan – Capital of Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico - Best of Tourism Travel Guide - 2024]

### **San Juan, Where Old World Elegance & Modern Caribbean Meet to Create the Most Vibrant and
### Romantic Destination in the Caribbean.**

#### Save a Spot - Top Culebra Day Trip from San Juan


Welcome to San Juan, the capital city of **[Puerto Rico][73]**, where Old World elegance, modern
luxuries, and tropical allure come together to offer unforgettable experiences like no other
destination.   Swim, [snorkel][74], surf, and relax at [San Juan’s beaches][75], explore the
historic and romantic district of [Old San Juan][76], and immerse yourself in the vibrant
[culture][77].  Whether you’re honeymooning, a solo traveler, a young family, or young at heart, San
Juan will deliver extraordinary experiences.

Go on a number of exciting [day trips from San Juan][78], such as exploring the [*El Yunque
Rainforest*][79], seeing the magic of the [bioluminescent bays][80], [sailing to secluded
islands][81], beach hopping to stunning beaches, exploring world-class [caves][82], going on[
off-road adventures][83], [ziplining][84], and much more.

## Experience Two Distinct Exciting Destinations

The Romance of European Charm & A Modern Tropical City

## Old San Juan / El Viejo San Juan

[[Old San Juan, Puerto Rico]][85]

[Old San Juan (*El Viejo San Juan*)][86] is the most beloved town in Puerto Rico by both locals and
visitors; you’ll feel like you’re in a European city, but more intimate, colorful, and certainly
livelier.  We invite you to make Old San Juan your first stop in Puerto Rico.  Wear comfortable
shoes; you’ll

### Read more

… want to walk every block leading to five-century-old forts, museums, cathedrals, elegant squares,
romantic promenades, delightful restaurants, and one-of-a-kind shops.  Immerse yourself in our
vibrant culture by joining the festive events celebrated throughout the year.  For honeymooners, the
Old City unfolds romantic experiences and quiet spots to cherish moments of love. Get lost in the
allure of this historic gem and create memories that linger in the heart.

[About Old San Juan][87] ⎮ [Hotels in Old San Juan][88] ⎮ [Old San Juan Tours][89]

## The New San Juan

[San Juan Puerto Rico]

Discover the ever-evolving “New San Juan,” the vibrant metropolis of the Caribbean that seamlessly
blends modernity with tropical allures.  Our capital city presents a dynamic fusion of urban
amenities and lively entertainment, complemented by the enchantment of tropical beaches…

### Read more

… lavish beachfront hotels, excellent dining options, shopping extravagance, and exhilarating
nightlife.  Explore the tourist hotspots of Condado, Ocean Park, and nearby Isla Verde, where you
can revel in the best of both worlds — experience the energy of bustling city life and unwind in the
true spirit of a fun and relaxing tropical escape. 

Take a few minutes to learn more about the **[Best Tourist Spots to Stay in San Juan][90]** that fit
your travel preference

## Tourism in San Juan, Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico 2023 - Tourism Guide]

Five centuries ago, San Juan was an impenetrable walled city; today, it is a hassle-free and
exciting tropical escape in the Caribbean, welcoming visitors with open arms.  San Juan is the most
popular tourist destination in Puerto Rico and a bustling cruise port in the Caribbean, giving
visitors world-class attractions, fun activities, and rich cultural experiences easily accessible,
so no precious vacation time is wasted.  

[Getting around San Juan][91] to enjoy it all is easy; no car rental is needed; you can walk to many
places, take a taxi or Uber, or enjoy scenic bicycle rides around the city.

### + Key Facts for Visitors
* If you’re a U.S. Citizen, there is no passport requirement; it is like traveling to another
  state. 
* There is no need to travel far; the average flight from many US city airports is just 3.5 hours. 
* Spanish and English are the official languages, and most of the staff in the tourism industry are
  bilingual. 
* No car rental is needed to explore and enjoy the city of San Juan. 
* Outside of the city, you can explore the natural wonders and fun things to do around the island;
  visitors can book tours with friendly professional guides or rent a car to explore at their own
  pace. 

This travel guide includes everything you need to help plan an extraordinary vacation.  Sit back,
relax, keep this page open, and begin your adventure in San Juan, Puerto Rico. 

## Experience The Beach Life of San Juan - Welcome to PRdise!

[[San Juan Puerto Rico Beaches - 2024 Guide]][92]

Indulge in the allure of San Juan’s stunning [beaches][93], each offering a unique experience from
snorkeling in clear waters with sea turtles at [Escambron][94] to sunbathing at the trendy [*Condado
Beach*][95], taking long walks on the golden sands of [Isla Verde][96], kiteboarding at [*Ocean
Park*][97], or, of course, doing nothing at all with a refreshing [Piña Colada][98] in hand.  If you
dream of seeing a dreamy beach, there’s a plethora of more pristine [beaches to visit around Puerto
Rico][99]; the hardest part of your vacation will be not having more days to explore, which is the
reason why so many visitors keep coming back to Puerto Rico. 

## Experience the Historical Marvels of San Juan

[San Juan National Historic Site - San Juan, Puerto Rico ]

San Juan, the oldest city under the United States Flag, celebrates 500 years of history.  Puerto
Rico became a Free Commonwealth (territory/colony) in 1898 following the Spanish-American War. 
Embark on a captivating journey in [Old San Juan][100], a [UNESCO World Heritage Site][101] that
unfolds like a living storybook full of history and legends. 

### Read more...

The majestic forts of [*El Morro*][102] and [*San Cristobal*][103], built five centuries ago to
protect the city, now stand as formidable guardians of the city’s rich history, offering
breathtaking panoramic views of the coastline and sharing tales of resilience and historical
significance.  Walk through the red-colored gate, walk into [*San Juan Bautista Cathedral*][104],
the second oldest church in the Western Hemisphere, take a tour of [Casa Blanca, Ponce de Leon’s
family mansion][105], and so much more.  You’re invited to experience San Juan’s historical marvels
of history and create your chapter in the captivating story of this historic gem.

## Experience The Natural Wonders & Fun Adventures of Puerto Rico

[[Best Places to Visit in Puerto Rico from San Juan]][106]

Get ready for a fun and adventurous vacation or as relaxing as you want it to be.  There’s plenty
to[ see and do in San Juan][107], but we encourage you to go beyond the city to [explore the
treasures around the island][108].  Take a hike at [*El Yunque Rainforest*][109] and jump into
gorgeous waterfalls, go on a [snorkeling excursion to the idyllic islands of Puerto Ric][110]o, go
[ziplining][111] or [horseback riding][112], have a thrilling [off-road][113] adventure, explore
caves, and have the best and most exciting beach hopping experience in the Caribbean.

**[See the wonderful adventures you can enjoy from San Juan][114]**.

## Where is San Juan, Puerto Rico?


San Juan is located on the north coast of Puerto Rico, a great location to explore the greatest
natural wonders and fun [activities of Puerto Rico][115].   Puerto Rico is situated in the Greater
Antilles of the Caribbean.  Spanning 35 miles from north to south and 100 miles from west to east,
makes Puerto Rico a wonderful destination for exploration; since no place is too far.   Puerto Rico
is nestled between the Caribbean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.  From San Juan, you can hop on a small
plane and visit the offshore islands of [Culebra][116] and [Vieques][117] for the most pristine
beaches and breathtaking landscapes that one may think only existed in the Caribbean of the past. 

## Experience San Juan's Hospitality

San Juan, Puerto Rico

[[San Juan Puerto Rico Hotels Guide 2024]][118]

San Juan’s diverse lodging options reflect the richness of its culture and the warmth of its
hospitality, ensuring that every visitor finds their perfect hotel, resort, or rental to feel at
home.  Whether you seek budget-friendly simplicity, family-oriented comfort, romantic, historic
charm, or lavish beachfront luxury, San Juan has the perfect lodging experience for your Caribbean
getaway. 

**We recommend you start by learning the differences among the **[**tourist districts / best places
to stay in San Juan**][119]. 

[Beachfront hotels in San Juan][120] ⎮ [Adults Only Hotels][121] ⎮ [Condado Hotels][122] ⎮ [Old San
Juan Hotels][123] ⎮ [Convention Center District Hotels][124] ⎮ [Hotels near Cruise Ports][125]  ⎮
[Casino Hotels in San Juan][126]

### Read more

**Budget-conscious **hotels, cozy guesthouses, and affordable hotels dot the city, offering a
wallet-friendly retreat without compromising comfort.  Saving money on accommodations in San Juan
doesn’t mean sacrificing fun; most budget-friendly hotels and small inns are within walking distance
to beaches and some attractions or a short taxi ride away.

**Families **with children can find spacious accommodations with kid-friendly activities and great
service to keep everyone comfortable.  Save a little money by staying just a block away from the
beach or rent an apartment with all the amenities of home.

**Romantics & History Buffs** – Old San Juan offers small inns and luxury hotels in beautifully
restored buildings for those yearning for a touch of history and Old World romance.  Immerse
yourself in the charm of colonial architecture while being steps away from all that Old San Juan has
to offer.

Experience the epitome of indulgence with our **luxury accommodations** in San Juan.  Select from a
range of exquisite options, from lavish waterfront and beachfront resorts like The Condado
Vanderbilt to the charm of elegant colonial buildings such as Palacio Provincial or El Convento.

# Welcome to San Juan, Puerto Rico
# 2026 Tourism Guide

[🇵🇷 Puerto Rico][72] ⎮ San Juan – Capital of Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico - Best of Tourism Travel Guide - 2024]

### **San Juan, Where Old World Elegance & Modern Caribbean Meet to Create the Most Vibrant and
### Romantic Destination in the Caribbean.**

#### Save a Spot - Top Culebra Day Trip from San Juan


Welcome to San Juan, the capital city of **[Puerto Rico][73]**, where Old World elegance, modern
luxuries, and tropical allure come together to offer unforgettable experiences like no other
destination.   Swim, [snorkel][74], surf, and relax at [San Juan’s beaches][75], explore the
historic and romantic district of [Old San Juan][76], and immerse yourself in the vibrant
[culture][77].  Whether you’re honeymooning, a solo traveler, a young family, or young at heart, San
Juan will deliver extraordinary experiences.

Go on a number of exciting [day trips from San Juan][78], such as exploring the [*El Yunque
Rainforest*][79], seeing the magic of the [bioluminescent bays][80], [sailing to secluded
islands][81], beach hopping to stunning beaches, exploring world-class [caves][82], going on[
off-road adventures][83], [ziplining][84], and much more.

## Experience Two Distinct Exciting Destinations

The Romance of European Charm & A Modern Tropical City

## Old San Juan / El Viejo San Juan

[[Old San Juan, Puerto Rico]][85]

[Old San Juan (*El Viejo San Juan*)][86] is the most beloved town in Puerto Rico by both locals and
visitors; you’ll feel like you’re in a European city, but more intimate, colorful, and certainly
livelier.  We invite you to make Old San Juan your first stop in Puerto Rico.  Wear comfortable
shoes; you’ll

### Read more

… want to walk every block leading to five-century-old forts, museums, cathedrals, elegant squares,
romantic promenades, delightful restaurants, and one-of-a-kind shops.  Immerse yourself in our
vibrant culture by joining the festive events celebrated throughout the year.  For honeymooners, the
Old City unfolds romantic experiences and quiet spots to cherish moments of love. Get lost in the
allure of this historic gem and create memories that linger in the heart.

[About Old San Juan][87] ⎮ [Hotels in Old San Juan][88] ⎮ [Old San Juan Tours][89]

## The New San Juan

[San Juan Puerto Rico]

Discover the ever-evolving “New San Juan,” the vibrant metropolis of the Caribbean that seamlessly
blends modernity with tropical allures.  Our capital city presents a dynamic fusion of urban
amenities and lively entertainment, complemented by the enchantment of tropical beaches…

### Read more

… lavish beachfront hotels, excellent dining options, shopping extravagance, and exhilarating
nightlife.  Explore the tourist hotspots of Condado, Ocean Park, and nearby Isla Verde, where you
can revel in the best of both worlds — experience the energy of bustling city life and unwind in the
true spirit of a fun and relaxing tropical escape. 

Take a few minutes to learn more about the **[Best Tourist Spots to Stay in San Juan][90]** that fit
your travel preferences.  

## Tourism in San Juan, Puerto Rico

[San Juan Puerto Rico 2023 - Tourism Guide]

Five centuries ago, San Juan was an impenetrable walled city; today, it is a hassle-free and
exciting tropical escape in the Caribbean, welcoming visitors with open arms.  San Juan is the most
popular tourist destination in Puerto Rico and a bustling cruise port in the Caribbean, giving
visitors world-class attractions, fun activities, and rich cultural experiences easily accessible,
so no precious vacation time is wasted.  

[Getting around San Juan][91] to enjoy it all is easy; no car rental is needed; you can walk to many
places, take a taxi or Uber, or enjoy scenic bicycle rides around the city.

### + Key Facts for Visitors
* If you’re a U.S. Citizen, there is no passport requirement; it is like traveling to another
  state. 
* There is no need to travel far; the average flight from many US city airports is just 3.5 hours. 
* Spanish and English are the official languages, and most of the staff in the tourism industry are
  bilingual. 
* No car rental is needed to explore and enjoy the city of San Juan. 
* Outside of the city, you can explore the natural wonders and fun things to do around the island;
  visitors can book tours with friendly professional guides or rent a car to explore at their own
  pace. 

This travel guide includes everything you need to help plan an extraordinary vacation.  Sit back,
relax, keep this page open, and begin your adventure in San Juan, Puerto Rico. 

## Experience The Beach Life of San Juan - Welcome to PRdise!

[[San Juan Puerto Rico Beaches - 2024 Guide]][92]

Indulge in the allure of San Juan’s stunning [beaches][93], each offering a unique experience from
snorkeling in clear waters with sea turtles at [Escambron][94] to sunbathing at the trendy [*Condado
Beach*][95], taking long walks on the golden sands of [Isla Verde][96], kiteboarding at [*Ocean
Park*][97], or, of course, doing nothing at all with a refreshing [Piña Colada][98] in hand.  If you
dream of seeing a dreamy beach, there’s a plethora of more pristine [beaches to visit around Puerto
Rico][99]; the hardest part of your vacation will be not having more days to explore, which is the
reason why so many visitors keep coming back to Puerto Rico. 

## Experience the Historical Marvels of San Juan

[San Juan National Historic Site - San Juan, Puerto Rico ]

San Juan, the oldest city under the United States Flag, celebrates 500 years of history.  Puerto
Rico became a Free Commonwealth (territory/colony) in 1898 following the Spanish-American War. 
Embark on a captivating journey in [Old San Juan][100], a [UNESCO World Heritage Site][101] that
unfolds like a living storybook full of history and legends. 

### Read more...

The majestic forts of [*El Morro*][102] and [*San Cristobal*][103], built five centuries ago to
protect the city, now stand as formidable guardians of the city’s rich history, offering
breathtaking panoramic views of the coastline and sharing tales of resilience and historical
significance.  Walk through the red-colored gate, walk into [*San Juan Bautista Cathedral*][104],
the second oldest church in the Western Hemisphere, take a tour of [Casa Blanca, Ponce de Leon’s
family mansion][105], and so much more.  You’re invited to experience San Juan’s historical marvels
of history and create your chapter in the captivating story of this historic gem.

## Experience The Natural Wonders & Fun Adventures of Puerto Rico

[[Best Places to Visit in Puerto Rico from San Juan]][106]

Get ready for a fun and adventurous vacation or as relaxing as you want it to be.  There’s plenty
to[ see and do in San Juan][107], but we encourage you to go beyond the city to [explore the
treasures around the island][108].  Take a hike at [*El Yunque Rainforest*][109] and jump into
gorgeous waterfalls, go on a [snorkeling excursion to the idyllic islands of Puerto Ric][110]o, go
[ziplining][111] or [horseback riding][112], have a thrilling [off-road][113] adventure, explore
caves, and have the best and most exciting beach hopping experience in the Caribbean.

**[See the wonderful adventures you can enjoy from San Juan][114]**.

## Where is San Juan, Puerto Rico?


San Juan is located on the north coast of Puerto Rico, a great location to explore the greatest
natural wonders and fun [activities of Puerto Rico][115].   Puerto Rico is situated in the Greater
Antilles of the Caribbean.  Spanning 35 miles from north to south and 100 miles from west to east,
makes Puerto Rico a wonderful destination for exploration; since no place is too far.   Puerto Rico
is nestled between the Caribbean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.  From San Juan, you can hop on a small
plane and visit the offshore islands of [Culebra][116] and [Vieques][117] for the most pristine
beaches and breathtaking landscapes that one may think only existed in the Caribbean of the past. 

## Experience San Juan's Hospitality

San Juan, Puerto Rico

[[San Juan Puerto Rico Hotels Guide 2024]][118]

San Juan’s diverse lodging options reflect the richness of its culture and the warmth of its
hospitality, ensuring that every visitor finds their perfect hotel, resort, or rental to feel at
home.  Whether you seek budget-friendly simplicity, family-oriented comfort, romantic, historic
charm, or lavish beachfront luxury, San Juan has the perfect lodging experience for your Caribbean
getaway. 

**We recommend you start by learning the differences among the **[**tourist districts / best places
to stay in San Juan**][119]. 

[Beachfront hotels in San Juan][120] ⎮ [Adults Only Hotels][121] ⎮ [Condado Hotels][122] ⎮ [Old San
Juan Hotels][123] ⎮ [Convention Center District Hotels][124] ⎮ [Hotels near Cruise Ports][125]  ⎮
[Casino Hotels in San Juan][126]

### Read more

**Budget-conscious **hotels, cozy guesthouses, and affordable hotels dot the city, offering a
wallet-friendly retreat without compromising comfort.  Saving money on accommodations in San Juan
doesn’t mean sacrificing fun; most budget-friendly hotels and small inns are within walking distance
to beaches and some attractions or a short taxi ride away.

**Families **with children can find spacious accommodations with kid-friendly activities and great
service to keep everyone comfortable.  Save a little money by staying just a block away from the
beach or rent an apartment with all the amenities of home.

**Romantics & History Buffs** – Old San Juan offers small inns and luxury hotels in beautifully
restored buildings for those yearning for a touch of history and Old World romance.  Immerse
yourself in the charm of colonial architecture while being steps away from all that Old San Juan has
to offer.

Experience the epitome of indulgence with our **luxury accommodations** in San Juan.  Select from a
range of exquisite options, from lavish waterfront and beachfront resorts like The Condado
Vanderbilt to the charm of elegant colonial buildings such as Palacio Provincial or El Convento.

# Discover Itineraries

Sunny Isles Beach is an ideal destination for both leisure and business travelers. With pristine
beaches, endless sunshine, and crystal-clear waters, it’s perfect for relaxation or adventure,
offering jet skiing, parasailing, and paddleboarding. Just minutes away, Aventura Mall boasts one of
the largest luxury shopping experiences in the U.S., while the Ancient Spanish Monastery offers a
unique cultural stop with lush gardens and historical charm.

[Explore][23]

### July 1 – August 31

# Miami Spa Months

This summer, let Miami Spa Months be your invitation to unwind in luxurious surroundings that make
every day a celebration of wellness.

Book your bliss today and discover the perfect escape to disconnect and renew in Miami.

the largest luxury shopping experiences in the U.S., while the Ancient Spanish Monastery offers a
unique cultural stop with lush gardens and historical charm.

## Discover the Charm of Vietnam

Step into the magical world of Vietnam!
A land where timeless beauty meets warm hospitality.
Enjoy our favourable visa policies including bilateral visa exemptions for selected countries,
45-day unilateral visa-free access for travellers from 24 nations and exclusive waivers for
celebrities and distinguished guests. For longer journeys, visitors can easily obtain 90-day e-visa
available for all nationalities, making entry smoother and more accessible.
A network of convenient direct international flights whisks you away to this mesmerizing
destination, where every journey begins effortlessly. Immerse yourself in pristine beaches and
idyllic islands, explore ancient treasures and UNESCO wonders, marvel at breathtaking landscapes,
savour legendary cuisine, and celebrate with vibrant festivals alive with tradition.
Vietnam invites you to create unforgettable stories, where every moment is a celebration of beauty,
culture, and adventure. Your extraordinary Vietnamese journey awaits - come, be enchanted!

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

[ Start your journey ][44]

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica regions

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

[Coffee beans]
Costa Rica Regions

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

[ explore the region ][47]

[An aerial view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica Regions

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

[ explore the region ][48]

[Arenal volcano]
Costa Rica regions

## Northern Plains


Arenal Volcano towers over protected forests and heats natural hot springs. Rivers and waterfalls
flow through landscapes that look like fairy-tale settings.

[ explore the region ][49]

[Puntarenas Lighthouse]
Costa Rica regions

## Puntarenas


Puntarenas is one of the most popular tourism regions, loved for its coastline dotted with inlets
and islands. Explore the jungle and spot wildlife in the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological
Preserve.

[ explore the region ][50]

[A woman riding a surfboard on top of a wave in the ocean]
Costa Rica regions

## South Pacific


The South Pacific area of Costa Rica is one of the most untouched regions and is covered in lush
rainforests and fringed by stunning beaches.

Central American experience. You won’t find anything else like it.

A global leader in sustainability, Costa Rica pioneers eco-friendly practices for travel and other
industries – both within the region and around the world.

## Visit the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve

If you like cool climates, views filled with green and hikes, this could be the destination you’ve
been looking for. The term “cloud forest” is no exaggeration, as you’ll be walking through trees in
the midst of a dense fog, produced at 1,600 meters above sea level.

[ read more ][82]

[Costa-Rica-hike-forest.png]
pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida pura vida

## 11 facts about Costa Rica that will surprise you

When it comes to Costa Rica, you’ve probably heard about “pura vida.” You probably know the
country’s biodiversity is off the charts, and maybe you even know that they got rid of their army
long ago. But beyond this basic info, what do you really know about the land of the ticos?

[ read more ][83]

From local Costa Rican cuisine to artisan crafts to traditional customs and celebrations,
sustainability is embedded deeply in the culture and traditions of Costa Rica.

No two trips to Costa Rica are the same. Share your beautiful moments with us and with everyone who

# Pura Vida

## Bienvenido a Costa Rica

Costa Rica is the land of pura vida. Take the quiz to discover your traveler type—and where your
journey begins.

[ Start your journey ][44]

## About Costa Rica

### An adventure, a retreat, an experience

Whether you’re seeking an adrenaline rush or deep relaxation – or a little of both – Costa Rica is
your ideal destination. We reserve more than a quarter of our land for conservation, meaning
undisturbed natural beauty is yours to enjoy. Top attractions with many activities call to visitors
from across the globe. Then in vibrant cities you’ll find fascinating art, history and
entertainment. We even have an official “Blue Zone” in the Nicoya Peninsula, meaning we have a high
number of centenarians thanks to our balanced diet, active lifestyle, strong social bonds and
integrated health care practices.

[Snorkeling adventure caribbean]
Costa Rica regions

## Caribbean


An enchanting combination of nature reserves and Afro Caribbean culture, the Caribbean region of
Costa Rica is known for sport fishing, birdwatching and exploring coral reefs.

[ explore the region ][45]

[A bird's eye view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica regions

## Central Pacific


Hiking, cycling, horseback riding and sport fishing are just a few of the activities the Central
Pacific region offers. Curious visitors can also explore rural tourism opportunities.

[ explore the region ][46]

[Coffee beans]
Costa Rica Regions

## Central Valley


Home to our capital city, the Central Valley boasts fascinating museums, riveting theater and
delicious food. Outside of the city you’ll find indigenous sites and natural wonders.

[ explore the region ][47]

[An aerial view of a beach and a body of water]
Costa Rica Regions

## Guanacaste


Guanacaste is known as the cradle of our folklore and is home to beautiful landscapes ranging from
tropical dry forests and pristine beaches to lowland mountain forests.

## Visit the Monteverde Cloud Forest Biological Reserve

If you like cool climates, views filled with green and hikes, this could be the destination you’ve
been looking for. The term “cloud forest” is no exaggeration, as you’ll be walking through trees in
the midst of a dense fog, produced at 1,600 meters above sea level.

[ read more ][82]

[Costa-Rica-hike-forest.png]

When it comes to Costa Rica, you’ve probably heard about “pura vida.” You probably know the
country’s biodiversity is off the charts, and maybe you even know that they got rid of their army
long ago. But beyond this basic info, what do you really know about the land of the ticos?

# Catch a real vibe

Long Beach has a feeling you notice as soon as you arrive. It's real, it's warm, it's creative...
It's a vibe.

From Retro Row to Brewery Knolls, SoCal's largest Aquarium, a historic ocean liner and so much more,
local experts have you covered with the best spots to eat, play and stay.

[View Expert Insights & Local Stories][51]
[FIFA World Cup 2026™][52]
Long Beach is your gateway to the FIFA World Cup 2026™ experience you've been dreaming about.
[Learn More][53]
[LA28 Olympics in Long Beach][54]
Long Beach is a premier destination for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosting eight major
athletic events during the games–the most of any city other than Los Angeles. With the city’s
stunning coastline providing the setting and an Olympic legacy that dates back to the 1932 Games,
Long Beach offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience the world’s biggest sporting event
up close.
[Learn More][55]

# Catch a real vibe

Long Beach has a feeling you notice as soon as you arrive. It's real, it's warm, it's creative...
It's a vibe.

From Retro Row to Brewery Knolls, SoCal's largest Aquarium, a historic ocean liner and so much more,
local experts have you covered with the best spots to eat, play and stay.

[View Expert Insights & Local Stories][51]
[FIFA World Cup 2026™][52]
Long Beach is your gateway to the FIFA World Cup 2026™ experience you've been dreaming about.
[Learn More][53]
[LA28 Olympics in Long Beach][54]
Long Beach is a premier destination for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, hosting eight major
athletic events during the games–the most of any city other than Los Angeles. With the city’s
stunning coastline providing the setting and an Olympic legacy that dates back to the 1932 Games,
Long Beach offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience the world’s biggest sporting event
up close.
[Learn More][55]
